/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.controller('cmnPopMbphAthzController', __controller);

	/* @ngInject */
	//function __controller($scope, $restConfigService, $restService, httpHeader){
	function __controller($scope, $state, $window, $timeout, $operationUtil, $commonService, $utilService, $chlBizAthzService, $popupService) {

		$scope.pager = $scope.$parent.pager;
		$scope.data = { gndrDvcd: '1' };
		$scope.readonly = { custNm: false, bryrMntd: false, gndrDvcd: false, mbphArNo: false, mbphOficNo: false, mbphEnNo: false };

		$scope.codes = {};

		$scope.isCountdown = false;
		$scope.isCountdownExpried = false;
		$scope.sendSmsTime = 0;
		$scope.resendSmsCount = 0;

		$scope.event = {
			init: evtInit,
			checkAgreeAll: evtCheckAgreeAll,
			checkAgreeFun: evtCheckAgreeFun,
			provPoupClick: evtProvPopClick,
			sendAthz: evtSendAthz, // 인증번호 발송
			confirmAthz: evtConfirmAthz, // 인증번호 확인
			reSendAthz: evtReSendAthz, // 인증번호 재발송
			timeExtension: evtTimeExtension, // 시간연장
			doneClick: evtDoneClick,
			cancelClick: evtCancelClick
		};

		function evtInit() {
			console.log('$scope', $scope);
			//$scope.parentWindow = $window.opener.$windowScope;

			if ($scope.popData['custNm']) {
				$scope.data.custNm = $scope.popData['custNm'];
				$scope.readonly.custNm = true;
			}

			if ($scope.popData['bryrMntd']) {
				$scope.data.bryrMntd = $scope.popData['bryrMntd'];
				$scope.readonly.bryrMntd = true;
			}

			if ($scope.popData['gndrDvcd']) {
				$scope.data.gndrDvcd = $scope.popData['gndrDvcd'] == '1' ? '1' : '0';
				$scope.readonly.gndrDvcd = true;
			}

			if ($scope.popData['mbphArNo']) {
				$scope.data.mbphArNo = $scope.popData['mbphArNo'];
				$scope.readonly.mbphArNo = true;
			}

			if ($scope.popData['mbphOficNo']) {
				$scope.data.mbphOficNo = $scope.popData['mbphOficNo'];
				$scope.readonly.mbphOficNo = true;
			}

			if ($scope.popData['mbphEnNo']) {
				$scope.data.mbphEnNo = $scope.popData['mbphEnNo'];
				$scope.readonly.mbphEnNo = true;
			}

			$scope.agree_AllData = [{ label: '본인인증약관 전체 동의합니다.', value: 'Y' }];
			$scope.agree_01Data = [{ label: '<span>[필수]</span> 본인확인 서비스 이용약관 동의', value: 'Y' }];
			$scope.agree_02Data = [{ label: '<span>[필수]</span> 고유식별정보 처리 동의', value: 'Y' }];
			$scope.agree_03Data = [{ label: '<span>[필수]</span> 이동통신사 이용약관 동의', value: 'Y' }];
			$scope.agree_04Data = [{ label: '<span>[필수]</span> 본인확인 개인정보 정보수집·이용 동의', value: 'Y' }];

			$scope.agree_01Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_01Data, '');
			$scope.agree_02Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_02Data, '');
			$scope.agree_03Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_03Data, '');
			$scope.agree_04Data = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_04Data, '');

			$scope.gndrDvcdData = [{ label: '남', value: '1' }, { label: '여', value: '0' }];
			$scope.gndrDvcdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.gndrDvcdData, $scope.data.gndrDvcd);

			$commonService.getCmnCdSubList('C0625,C0171', function (data) {
				$timeout(function () {
					$scope.codes['C0625'] = data['C0625']; // 통신사+알뜰
					$scope.codes['C0171'] = data['C0171']; // 통신사
				});
			});
		}

		function evtCheckAgreeAll(modelNm, val) {
			var yn = val === 'Y' ? 'Y' : '';

			$timeout(function () {
				$scope.data.agree_01 = yn;
				$scope.data.agree_02 = yn;
				$scope.data.agree_03 = yn;
				$scope.data.agree_04 = yn;
			});
		}

		function evtCheckAgreeFun(modelNm, val) {
			$timeout(function () {
				var allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04'], 'Y');
				var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
				$scope.data.agree_All = yn;
			});
		}

		function evtProvPopClick(code, title, e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopImmediatePropagation();
			$popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code, title: title }, function () {
				var yn = 'Y';
				if (code == '00022') {
					$scope.data.agree_01 = yn;
				} else if (code == '00026') {
					$scope.data.agree_02 = yn;
				} else if (code == '00024') {
					$scope.data.agree_03 = yn;
				} else if (code == '00025') {
					$scope.data.agree_04 = yn;
				}

				$timeout(function () {
					var allYn = $utilService.isEqualAllValue($scope.data, ['agree_01', 'agree_02', 'agree_03', 'agree_04'], 'Y');
					var yn = allYn ? 'Y' : 'N';
					$scope.agree_AllData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.agree_AllData, [yn]);
				});
			});
		}

		function evtSendAthz(resend) {
			if (!$utilService.validateCheck($scope.data, { 'custNm': '성명', 'cmncCmDvcd': '통신사', 'bryrMntd': '생년월일', 'gndrDvcd': '성별', 'mbphArNo': '휴대폰 앞 번호', 'mbphOficNo': '휴대폰 가운데 번호', 'mbphEnNo': '휴대폰 끝 번호' }, $scope, 'data')) {
				return;
			}
			if ($scope.data.bryrMntd.length != 8) {
				$utilService.openAlert('생년월일을 정확히 입력해 주세요.');
				return;
			}

			if ($scope.data.agree_01 != 'Y') {
				$utilService.openAlert('본인확인 서비스 이용약관 동의해야 합니다.');
				return;
			}
			if ($scope.data.agree_02 != 'Y') {
				$utilService.openAlert('고유식별정보 처리 동의해야 합니다.');
				return;
			}
			if ($scope.data.agree_03 != 'Y') {
				$utilService.openAlert('이동통신사 이용약관 동의해야 합니다.');
				return;
			}
			if ($scope.data.agree_04 != 'Y') {
				$utilService.openAlert('본인확인 개인정보 정보수집·이용 동의해야 합니다.');
				return;
			}

			var provCont = new Array();
			provCont.push($scope.agree_01Data[0].label + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_01) + ', ');
			provCont.push($scope.agree_02Data[0].label + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_02) + ', ');
			provCont.push($scope.agree_03Data[0].label + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_03) + ', ');
			provCont.push($scope.agree_04Data[0].label + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_04) + '');

					$scope.data.dlnsSqno = dto.subEai.dlnsSqno;

					lonCountDown(resend);
				}
			});
		}

		function evtConfirmAthz() {

		function evtReSendAthz() {
			var currentTime = new Date().getTime();

			if (duration < $chlBizAthzService.resendSmsDuration) {

				return;

				$utilService.openAlert('최대 ' + $chlBizAthzService.resendSmslimitCount + '회까지만 재발송 가능합니다.', function () {
					evtCancelClick();
				});
				return;
			}

			evtSendAthz(true);
		}

		function evtCancelClick() {
			$scope.pager.close();
		}

		function lonCountDown(resendCount) {
			$scope.sendSmsTime = new Date().getTime();
			if (resendCount) {
				// 재발송시 카운트
				$scope.resendSmsCount = $scope.resendSmsCount + 1;
			}

			$scope.isCountdown = true;
			$scope.isCountdownExpried = false;
			var fiveSeconds = new Date().getTime() + 1000 * 60 * 3;
			$('span#time').countdown(fiveSeconds, { elapse: false }).on('update.countdown', function (event) {
				$(this).html(event.strftime('%M:%S'));
			}).on('finish.countdown', function (event) {
				//$scope.isCountdown = false;
				$scope.isCountdownExpried = true;
				$(this).html('입력시간 초과');
			});
		}

		$scope.event.init();
	}

	function __controller($scope, $state, $window, $timeout, $operationUtil, $commonService, $utilService, $chlBizCmnService) {

		$scope.data = {
			intrSrch: '',
			totalCount: 0,
			pageNo: 1,
			rowNum: 5,
			addrType: '',
			showPlaceH: false,
			totAddList: [],

		};

		$scope.event = {
			init: evtInit,
			doneClick: evtDoneClick,
			close: evtCloseClick,
			enter01: evtEnter01,
			onSearch: evtOnSearch,
			goPage: evtGoPage,

		function evtInit() {

			$scope.data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, $scope.$parent.popData);

			if ($scope.$parent['dynamicParam']) {
				$.each($scope.$parent['dynamicParam'], function (key) {
					$scope.pager = $scope.$parent['dynamicParam'][key];
				});
			} else {
				$scope.pager = $scope.$parent.pager;
			}

			stepView(stepManger('init'));

			var ieName = navigator.appName;
			if (ieName == "Microsoft Internet Explorer") {
				ckBroVer(); // 익스플로러일때 브라우저 버전 체크
			}

			function ckBroVer() {

				var version;
				var agent = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();

				var reg = new RegExp("msie ([0-9]{1,}[\.0-9]{0,})");
				if (reg.exec(agent) != null) version = parseFloat(RegExp.$1);

				if (version <= 9) {
					// 9버전 이하이면

					$scope.data.showPlaceH = true;
					$(document).on('focus', 'input[id=tmd_nm]', function (e) {
						if (e.type == 'focusin') {
							$scope.data.showPlaceH = false;
						}
					});
				}
			}
		}

		function evtGoPage(pageNum) {
			$scope.addrList = $scope.data.totAddList[pageNum];
		}

		function stepManger(state) {

			var firstStep = 0;
			var lastStep = 3;

			if ($scope.data.step == 9) {
				if (state == 'next') $scope.data.step = 3;else if (state == 'prve') $scope.data.step = 0;

				return $scope.data.step;
			}

			if (state === 'next') $scope.data.step = $scope.data.step >= lastStep ? lastStep : ++$scope.data.step;else if (state === 'prve') $scope.data.step = $scope.data.step <= firstStep ? firstStep : --$scope.data.step;else if (state === 'init') $scope.data.step = 0;else if (state === 'addrError') $scope.data.step = 9;

			return $scope.data.step;
		}

		function evtClickAddrData(rowData, type) {
			if (rowData) {
				if (type && ['N', 'J'].indexOf(type) > -1) {
					$scope.data.addrType = type;
					$scope.data.addrData = rowData;
					$scope.data.addrDt = "[" + rowData.zipb + "] " + rowData.doroNm;
					$scope.data.addrDetail = '';
				}
				$scope.data.rAddrData = rowData.radio;
			}
		}

		function evtClickAptData(rowData) {

			if (rowData) {
				$scope.data.aptData = rowData;
			}
		}

		function stepView(step) {
			console.log('step', step);
			if (step == 9) {
				$('#search_1_1').hide();
				$('#search_1_2').hide();
				$('#search_2_1').hide();
				$('#search_2_9').show();
				$('#search_3_1').hide();
			} else {
				$('#search_2_9').hide();
			}

			switch (step) {
				case 0:
					$('#search_1_1').show();
					$('#search_1_2').hide();
					$('#search_2_1').hide();
					$('#search_3_1').hide();
					break;
				case 1:
					$('#search_1_1').show();
					$('#search_1_2').show();
					$('#search_2_1').hide();
					$('#search_3_1').hide();
					break;
				case 2:
					$('#search_1_1').hide();
					$('#search_1_2').hide();
					$('#search_2_1').show();
					$('#search_3_1').hide();

					//2024년 하반기 웹접근성 심사 관련 추가소스
					$timeout(function () {
						var rdoCmp = $("input[name=radio-job2]");
						if (rdoCmp.length > 0) {
							rdoCmp.eq(0).prop('checked', true);
							rdoCmp.eq(0).focus();
						}
					});
					break;
				case 3:
					$('#search_1_1').hide();
					$('#search_1_2').hide();
					$('#search_2_1').hide();
					$('#search_3_1').show();
					break;
				default:
					break;
			}
		}

		function evtFirstStepClick() {
			$scope.data.rAddrData = undefined;
			$scope.data.addrData = undefined;
			$scope.data.aptData = undefined;
			$scope.data.rAptData = undefined;
			$scope.data.detailAddr = '';
			$scope.data.mrvlLst = undefined;

			$scope.data.step = 0;
			stepView(stepManger('init'));
		}

		function evtNextStepClick(step) {

			switch (step) {
				case 1:
					searchDanji();
					break;
				case 2:
					searchKbAptMrvLst();
					break;
				case 3:
					evtDoneClick();
					break;
				case 9:
					stepView(stepManger('next'));
					break;
				default:
					break;

			}
		}

		function searchDanji() {
			debugger;

			function renameSido(sido) {
				if (!sido) {
					return "";
				}

				if (/서울/.test(sido)) {
					return "서울시";
				} else if (/부산/.test(sido)) {
					return "부산시";
				} else if (/대전/.test(sido)) {
					return "대전시";
				} else if (/대구/.test(sido)) {
					return "대구시";
				} else if (/인천/.test(sido)) {
					return "인천시";
				} else if (/광주/.test(sido)) {
					return "광주시";
				} else if (/울산/.test(sido)) {
					return "울산시";
				} else if (/세종/.test(sido)) {
					return "세종시";
				} else if (/경기/.test(sido)) {
					return "경기도";
				} else if (/강원/.test(sido)) {
					return "강원특별자치도";
				} else if (/충북/.test(sido)) {
					return "충청북도";
				} else if (/충남/.test(sido)) {
					return "충청남도";
				} else if (/전북/.test(sido)) {
					return "전라북도";
				} else if (/전남/.test(sido)) {
					return "전라남도";
				} else if (/경북/.test(sido)) {
					return "경상북도";
				} else if (/경남/.test(sido)) {
					return "경상남도";
				} else if (/제주/.test(sido)) {
					return "제주도";
				}
			}

			if (!$scope.data.addrData || $scope.data.addrData === '') {
				$utilService.openAlert('주소를 선택해주세요.');
				return;
			}

			var val = $scope.data.addrData;

			var sTbEx3720m01InDto = {
				lrclArNm: "",
				mdcfArNm: "",
				smclArNm: ""
			};

			var jibunNm = (val.jibunNm || '').split(' ');
			if (jibunNm.length == 4) {
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.lrclArNm = renameSido(jibunNm[0]);
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.mdcfArNm = jibunNm[1];
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.smclArNm = jibunNm[2];
			} else if (jibunNm.length > 4) {
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.lrclArNm = renameSido(jibunNm[0]);
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.mdcfArNm = jibunNm[1] + ' ' + jibunNm[2];
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.smclArNm = jibunNm[3];
			} else if (jibunNm.length == 3) {
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.lrclArNm = renameSido(jibunNm[0]);
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.mdcfArNm = renameSido(jibunNm[0]);
				sTbEx3720m01InDto.smclArNm = jibunNm[1];
			} else {
				stepView(stepManger('addrError'));
				return;
			}

			var aptName = val.doroNm;
			if (aptName.length > val.vrfcDoroNm.length) {
				aptName = aptName.substring(val.vrfcDoroNm.length + 1);
			}

			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(sTbEx3720m01InDto, { service: 'SCmnPopAddrSerch', operation: 'getTbEx3720mList04' }), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {
				var list = sortApt(aptName, data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.sub);

				if (list && list.length > 0) {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.hsngList = list;
						stepView(stepManger('next'));
					});
				} else {
					stepView(stepManger('addrError'));
				}
			});
		}

		function sortApt(nm, list) {
			var sanmKey = nm;
			var similarKey = nm.replace(/[아파트|단지|APT]/gi, '');

			list.forEach(function (val) {
				if (val.value == sanmKey) {
					val.sort = 0;
				} else if (val.value.indexOf(similarKey) > -1) {
					val.sort = 1;
				} else {
					val.sort = 2;
				}
			});

			list.sort(function (a, b) {
				if (a.sort > b.sort) {
					return 1;
				}
				if (a.sort == b.sort) {
					return 0;
				}
				if (a.sort < b.sort) {
					return -1;
				}
			});

			return list;
		}

		function evtEnter01(e) {
			var keyCode = e.which ? e.which : e.keyCode;
			if (keyCode == 13) {
				evtOnSearch();
				return false;
			}
		}

		// 조회버튼 클릭시
		function evtOnSearch() {

			$scope.data.totAddList = [];
			stepView(stepManger('init'));

			var data = {
				intrSrch: $scope.data.intrSrch || ''
			};

			if ($scope.data.intrSrch == null || $scope.data.intrSrch == '') {
				$utilService.openAlert('찾고자 하는 도로명+건물주소/동,읍,면+번지 입력해 주십시요.');
				return;
			}

			var dim = $utilService.getDimmed($('.container1'));

			$chlBizCmnService.getAddrintrSrch(data, function (data) {
				var addrList = [];
				if (data.SAddrintrSrchOutDto && data.SAddrintrSrchOutDto.subEai.adrLst) {

					$.each(data.SAddrintrSrchOutDto.subEai.adrLst, function (idx, dto) {
						var arrayIdx = parseInt(idx / 5) + 1;

						if ($scope.data.totAddList[arrayIdx] === undefined) $scope.data.totAddList[arrayIdx] = [];

						$scope.data.totAddList[arrayIdx].push(dto);
					});

					$scope.data.totalCount = data.SAddrintrSrchOutDto.subEai.adrLst.length;
				}

						};

						evtOnCancel(callbackData);
					}

		function getSearchList(data) {

				if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto) {

					//조회건수

						//디지털채널팀 류다혜대리님 - PF대출만 억원 나오게 해달라고 요청
						data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].lonHghsAmt2 = 0;
						if ("P700190155" == data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].bspGdsCd) {
							data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].lonHghsAmt2 = Number(data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].lonHghsAmt.toString().slice(0, -4));
						}

						// 111론 고정된 금액, 금리 나오게 변경 / 소비자금융기획팀 한은지 과장님 요청
						data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].lonHghsAmt111 = 0;
						data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].lowsRti111 = 0;
						if ("0201001100" == data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].bspGdsCd) {
							data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].lonHghsAmt111 = 1;

						if (Number(data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].hghsRti) > 0 && Number(data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].hghsRti) == Number(data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub[i].lowsRti)) {

						}
					}

					$scope.selectObject = data.SMaGdsLon01OutDto.sub;
				}
			});

		function evtSetClbcRsrt() {
			var hm = $dateUtil.getHm24Now();
			var hh = parseInt(hm.substring(0, 2), 10);
			var mm = parseInt(hm.substring(2), 10);

			mm = (mm / 10).toFixed(0) * 10;
			mm += 30;

			if (mm > 60) {
				hh += 1;
				mm -= 60;
			}

			if (hh > 23) {
				hh = 23;
				mm = 55;
			}

			$scope.data.clbcRsrtHH = '' + hh;
			$scope.data.clbcRsrtMM = '' + mm;
		}

		function evtEsnsRqusClick() {

						return;
					}

					if ($scope.data.clbcRsrt == 1) {
						var hm = $dateUtil.getHm24Now();
						var hh = parseInt(hm.substring(0, 2), 10);
						var mm = parseInt(hm.substring(2), 10);

						if ($scope.data.clbcRsrtHH < hh) {
							$utilService.openAlert('희망시간이 잘못되었습니다.');
							return;

						if ($scope.data.clbcRsrtHH == hh && $scope.data.clbcRsrtMM < mm) {
							$utilService.openAlert('희망시간이 잘못되었습니다.');
							return;
						}
					}

					var clbcRsrtDt = $scope.data.clbcRsrt == 2 ? $dateUtil.afterDay(1) : $dateUtil.getToday('yyyymmdd');
					var clbcRsrtHms = ($scope.data.clbcRsrtHH < 10 ? '0' + $scope.data.clbcRsrtHH : '' + $scope.data.clbcRsrtHH) + ($scope.data.clbcRsrtMM < 10 ? '0' + $scope.data.clbcRsrtMM : '' + $scope.data.clbcRsrtMM);

						mbphArNo: $scope.data.mbphArNo,

/***/ "./views/lon/esns/esns_cuns100_controller.js":
/*!***************************************************!*\
  !*** ./views/lon/esns/esns_cuns100_controller.js ***!
  \***************************************************/


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HEADER CANDIDATE #23
PATTERN=httpHeader
POSITION=643734
SCORE=50
MATCHED=[]

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.factory('utmFactory', __factory);

	function __factory($timeout, $sessionStorageService, $commonService, $utilService, $cmnUtil, httpHeader) {
		var factory = {};
		var cookId = 'C-' + new Date().getTime() + lpad(Math.floor($cmnUtil.getRandom() * 999), 3, '0');
		var utm_key = '';
		var utm_data = {};

		factory.init = init;
		factory.setUtmKey = setUtmKey;
		factory.hasUtm = hasUtm;
		factory.setLastUrl = setLastUrl;
		factory.utmToParam = utmToParam;
		factory.get = get;
		factory.print = print;
		factory.getSessionCookId = getSessionCookId;

		var lastUrl = '';

		return factory;

		function lpad(str, size, padChar) {
			return new Array(size - new String(str).length + 1).join(padChar || '0') + str;
		}

		function init(googleCookieID) {
			console.log('utm_factory init', googleCookieID);
			if (typeof googleCookieID !== 'undefined') {
				setCookId(googleCookieID);
			}

			parseUtm();
		}

		function setCookId(googleCookieID) {
			console.log('utm_factory cookid', googleCookieID);

			var utm = getSUtm();

			if (!utm.cookId) {
				cookId = googleCookieID;

				utm_data.cookId = cookId;
				utm.cookId = cookId;
				setSUtm(utm);
			}
		}

		function getSessionCookId() {
			return getSUtm().cookId || '';
		}

		function setUtmKey(ciEnc) {
			utm_key = ciEnc;

			utm_data.utm_key = utm_key;
			var utm = getSUtm();
			utm.utm_key = utm_key;
			setSUtm(utm);
		}

		function parseUtm() {
			var utm_source = $utilService.getParamVal('utm_source');
			var utm_medium = $utilService.getParamVal('utm_medium');
			var utm_term = $utilService.getParamVal('utm_term');
			var utm_campaign = $utilService.getParamVal('utm_campaign');
			var utm_content = $utilService.getParamVal('utm_content');
			var utm_mirt = $utilService.getParamVal('utm_mirt');

			var utm = getSUtm();
			utm_data = {
				cookId: cookId || utm.cookId,
				utm_key: utm_key || utm.utm_key,
				utm_source: utm_source || utm_data.utm_source || utm.utm_source,
				utm_medium: utm_medium || utm_data.utm_medium || utm.utm_medium,
				utm_term: utm_term || utm_data.utm_term || utm.utm_term,
				utm_campaign: utm_campaign || utm_data.utm_campaign || utm.utm_campaign,
				utm_content: utm_content || utm_data.utm_content || utm.utm_content,
				utm_mirt: utm_mirt || utm_data.utm_mirt || utm.utm_mirt
			};

			setSUtm(utm_data);
		}

		function getSUtm() {
			return $sessionStorageService.get('utm') || {};
		}

		function setSUtm(utm) {
			$sessionStorageService.set('utm', utm);
		}

		function get(key) {
			var k = key.toLowerCase();
			if (k === 'cookid') {
				return cookId || utm_data['cookId'] || getSUtm()['cookId'] || '';
			}
			if (k === 'utm_key') {
				return utm_key || utm_data['utm_key'] || getSUtm()['utm_key'] || '';
			}
			if (k === 'utm_source') {
				return utm_data['utm_source'] || getSUtm()['utm_source'] || '';
			}
			if (k === 'utm_medium') {
				return utm_data['utm_medium'] || getSUtm()['utm_medium'] || '';
			}
			if (k === 'utm_term') {
				return utm_data['utm_term'] || getSUtm()['utm_term'] || '';
			}
			if (k === 'utm_campaign') {
				return utm_data['utm_campaign'] || getSUtm()['utm_campaign'] || '';
			}
			if (k === 'utm_content') {
				return utm_data['utm_content'] || getSUtm()['utm_content'] || '';
			}
			if (k === 'utm_mirt') {
				//	 중금리에서만 사용 
				return (/01|29|30/.test(get('utm_campaign') || '') ? 'Y' : 'N'
				);
			}

			return '';
		}

		function hasUtm() {
			return !!get('cookId'); // get('cookId') && 
		}

		function utmToParam(param) {
			param = param || {};
			param.cookId = get('cookId') || lastUrl;
			param.cmpgSrce = get('utm_source');
			param.cmpgMedm = get('utm_medium');
			param.cmpgTerm = get('utm_term');
			param.cmpgNm = get('utm_campaign');
			param.cmpgExpl = get('utm_content');

			return param;
		}

		function setLastUrl(url) {
			lastUrl = (url || '').length > 50 ? url.substring(0, 50) : url;
		}

		function print() {
			console.log('utm_factory utm_data', utm_data);
			console.log('utm_factory utm_session', getSUtm());
		}
	}

			} else {
				page = $scope.data.url;
			}

			$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);

				$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
			});

					//금액단위 설정 여신기획팀 김영형 대리님 - 억원 추가 요청
					//디지털채널팀 류다혜대리님 - PF대출만 억원 나오게 해달라고 요청
					$scope.data['lonHghsAmt2'] = 0;
					if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['bspGdsCd'] == 'P700190155') {
						$scope.data['lonHghsAmt2'] = Number(data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['lonHghsAmt'].toString().slice(0, -4));
					}

					// 111론 고정된 금액, 금리 나오게 변경 / 소비자금융기획팀 한은지 과장님 요청
					$scope.data['lonHghsAmt111'] = 0;
					$scope.data['lowsRti111'] = 0;
					if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['bspGdsCd'] == '0201001100') {
						$scope.data['lonHghsAmt111'] = 1;
						$scope.data['lowsRti111'] = 1;
						$scope.lmtBtnActvYn = 'N'; // 한도조회버튼 숨김
						$scope.cunsBtnActvYn = 'N'; // 대출신청버튼 숨김
					}

					// 홈페이지 관리자페이지 금리정보 표기방식 변경 (SR_317583)
					if (Number($scope.data['hghsRti']) > 0 && Number($scope.data['hghsRti']) == Number($scope.data['lowsRti'])) {
						$scope.data['lowsRti111'] = '1';
					}
				}
			});
		}

		//관련상품이동
		function evtMoveToPage(concTp, concSqno, menuCd, menuUrl) {
			if (concTp) {
				if (menuCd == $scope.data.menuCd) {
					var param = { lonGdsSqno: concSqno, menuCd: menuCd };

					$scope.data.lonGdsSqno = concSqno;
					$scope.data['etryLowsAmt'] = 0;

					evtSrcClick();
					$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
					param = $.extend(true, $location.$$search ? $location.$$search : {}, param);

					$utilService.go(menuUrl, param, $scope, function () {
						evtSrcClick();
						$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
					});
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { lonGdsSqno: concSqno, menuCd: menuCd });
				}
			} else {
				var key = {
					menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
					pageNo: $utilService.getParamVal('pageNo'),
					lonHghsAmt: $utilService.getParamVal('lonHghsAmt'),
					lonAmtSrchCd: $utilService.getParamVal('lonAmtSrchCd'),
					rfndMetdCd: $utilService.getParamVal('rfndMetdCd'),
					rqusObjcCd: $utilService.getParamVal('rqusObjcCd'),
					charTagCd: $utilService.getParamVal('charTagCd'),
					arayGdsNm: $utilService.getParamVal('arayGdsNm'),
					arayInrt: $utilService.getParamVal('arayInrt')
				};

				$utilService.go($scope.data.page, key);
			}
		}

		// 페이지 이동
		function evtMoveToPage2(type) {
			console.log($scope.data);
			var param = { lonGdsSqno: $scope.data.lonGdsSqno, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd };
			var page = '';

			var brfGdsInfo = $scope.data.brfGdsInfo;
			if (brfGdsInfo && brfGdsInfo.srvcYn == 'N') {
				var srvcMsg = brfGdsInfo.srvcMsg || "상품 이용 가능 시간이 아닙니다.<br>(" + brfGdsInfo.srvcStrt + "~" + brfGdsInfo.srvcEnd + ")";
				$utilService.openAlert(srvcMsg, function () {
					$utilService.go($scope.data.page);
				});
				return;
			}

			switch (type) {
				case 'A':
					//한도조회
					page = $scope.data.pcLmtUrl;
					break;
				case 'B':
					//상담신청
					if ($scope.okStockLonFlag) {
						//스탁OK론일 경우
						window.open('https://stock.oksavingsbank.com/stock', '_blank');

							console.log("cmnPopOnlnSnsnChck data ", data);
						});
						return;
					} else {
						page = $scope.data.pcCunsUrl;
						param.gdsClsnCd = $scope.data.gdsClsnCd; // 상품구분코드
						param.gdsCd = $scope.data.gdsCd; // 상품코드
						param.bspGdsCd = $scope.data.bspGdsCd; // 대출상품코드
						param.gdsNm = $scope.data.gdsNm; // 대출상품명

					}
					break;
			}

			$utilService.go(page, param);
		}

		// url치환 function
		function urlVaild(data, key) {

			for (var i = 0; i < data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key].length; i++) {
				var tempInfoMap = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i];
				var contRst = tempInfoMap.cont.replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
				var urlSrh = tempInfoMap.cont.match(/@.*?@/g);
				if (urlSrh) {
					var redirectUrl = urlSrh[0].match(/\(.*?\)/g);
					redirectUrl = redirectUrl[0].replace(/\(|\)/g, "");
					var urlName = urlSrh[0].replace("(" + redirectUrl + ")", "");

					//모바일url과 홈페이지 url 이 달라 정상로드되지 않는경우 
					if ("/#/bank_bsbr_gd" == redirectUrl) {
						//영업점안내
						redirectUrl = "/#/bankBsbrGd";
					}

					urlName = "<a href =" + redirectUrl + " target=\"_blank\" title=\"새창열림\">" + urlName + "</a>";
					data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i].cont = contRst.replace(urlSrh, urlName).replace(/@/g, "");
				} else {
					data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i].cont = contRst;
				}
			}
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;

			if (concTp) {
				if (menuCd == $scope.data.menuCd) {
					$scope.data.url = menuUrl;
					$scope.data.depsGdsSqno = concSqno;
					$scope.data['etryLowsAmt'] = 0;

					evtSrcClick();
					$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);

					var key = { depsGdsSqno: concSqno, pageNo: $scope.data.pageNo, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
						mngmTr: $utilService.getParamVal('mngmTr'), inrtTp: $utilService.getParamVal('inrtTp'),
						etryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('etryMthd'), acmlMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('acmlMthd'), entrObjc: $utilService.getParamVal('entrObjc'),
						frdmEtryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('frdmEtryMthd')
					};

					$utilService.go($scope.data.url, key, $scope, function () {
						$scope.data['etryLowsAmt'] = 0;
						evtSrcClick();
						$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
					});
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { depsGdsSqno: concSqno, menuCd: menuCd });
				}
			} else {
				var locationPath = $location.$$path;
				$scope.data.url = locationPath.substr(0, locationPath.length - 3) + "List";

				var key = { pageNo: $scope.data.pageNo, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
					mngmTr: $utilService.getParamVal('mngmTr'), inrtTp: $utilService.getParamVal('inrtTp'),
					etryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('etryMthd'), acmlMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('acmlMthd'), entrObjc: $utilService.getParamVal('entrObjc'),
					frdmEtryMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('frdmEtryMthd')
				};

				$utilService.go($scope.data.url, key);
			}
		}

		function setLocation(location) {
			if (!$rootScope['location']) {
				$rootScope['location'] = new Array(4);
			}
			if (location.indexOf('>') != -1) {
				var locationArray = location.split('>');
				$.each(locationArray, function (idx) {
					$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: locationArray[idx] };
				});
			}
		}

							} else {
								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '			<div class="recom-cont-txt3 ' + classPrimary + '">';
								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '				<p class="txt-color">최저 연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.gdsDepsList[idx]['lowsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '				<p class="txt-color">최고 연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.gdsDepsList[idx]['hghsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '			</div>';
							}

							depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		</div>';
							depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '	</div>';

							$('.product2').find('.recom-tab-cont').find('ul.recom-list > li > a').eq(idx).html(depsAddHtml);

							$('.product2').find('.recom-tab-cont').find('ul.recom-list > li > a').eq(idx).on('click', function () {

								$utilService.go(gdsMenuUrl, { 'menuCd': gdsMenuCd, 'depsGdsSqno': depsGdsSqno });
							});
						});
					}
				}
			}); // -- 추천 예적금상품 정보 조회

			//공지사항 영역 마우스오버에 대한 스크롤 주도권 변경
			var $newsBody = $('.news-body');
		}

		// =================================
		// 이벤트 설정
		// =================================
		function setEvent() {
			// ---------------------------------
			// 상품안내
			// ---------------------------------

			// 대출/예.적금 상품 탭
			mainTabFnc('.product-select-tab .tab-title');

			$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3); //대출 전용 변수 - 기존 변수
			$scope.slctCdsListDeposit = new Array(2); //예금 전용 변수 - 신규 생성

			// OK 맞춤상품 대출/예.적금 탭 클릭
			$('.tab-title').on('click', function () {
				$('.product-select-tab a.tab-title').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
				$(this).attr('aria-expanded', 'true');

				$scope.slctGubn = $(this).data('gubn');

				//선택항목이 초기화되지않는 상황에 배열만 초기화되다보니 오동작이 발생함
				//	        	$scope.slctCdsList = null;
				//	        		
				//	        	if (gubn == "lon") {
				//	        		$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3);
				//	        		
				//	        	} else if (gubn == "deposit") {
				//	        		$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(2);
				//	        	}
			});

			$('.product-select-tab .active a.tab-title').trigger('click');

			// OK 맞춤상품 조회조건 담기
			$('button.btn-product-select').on('click', function () {

				var step = $(this).find('span.txt-sel').data('step');
				var value = $(this).find('span.txt-sel').data('value');
				var index = Number(step) - 1;

				if ($scope.slctGubn == 'lon') {

					if ($scope.slctCdsList == null) {
						$scope.slctCdsList = new Array(3);
					}

					//사용하는 속성만 남기고 내용을 비운다
					for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
						if (i >= index) {
							$scope.slctCdsList[i] = null;
						}
					}

					$scope.slctCdsList[index] = value;

					if (Number(step) === 3) {
						searchProduct(step);
					} else {
						var stepHtml = '<span aria-label="3단계 중 ' + (step + 1) + '단계">' + (step + 1) + '/3</span>';
						$('#lon_cur_step').html(stepHtml);
					}
				} else if ($scope.slctGubn == 'deposit') {

					if ($scope.slctCdsListDeposit == null) {
						$scope.slctCdsListDeposit = new Array(2);
					}

					//사용하는 속성만 남기고 내용을 비운다
					for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
						if (i >= index) {
							$scope.slctCdsListDeposit[i] = null;
						}
					}

					$scope.slctCdsListDeposit[index] = value;

					if (Number(step) === 2) {
						searchProduct(step);
					} else {
						var stepHtml = '<span aria-label="2단계 중 ' + (step + 1) + '단계">' + (step + 1) + '/2</span>';
						$('#deposit_cur_step').html(stepHtml);
					}
				}
			});

			// ---------------------------------
			// 사회공헌
			// ---------------------------------

			// 사회공헌 card 클릭 이벤트
			cardFnc('.contrib-card');

			// ---------------------------------
			// 은행소식
			// ---------------------------------


			// ---------------------------------
			// 금융소비자보호
			// ---------------------------------


			// ---------------------------------
			// FOOTER 함수
			// ---------------------------------
			$('.family-area').click(function () {
				$('.family-site').toggleClass('active');
				$('.family-area').toggleClass('on');
				$('.family', $(this).parent()).slideToggle();
				if ($(this).hasClass('on')) {
					$(this).attr('aria-expanded', true);
				} else {
					$(this).attr('aria-expanded', false);
				}
				return false;
			});

			$('.family').mouseleave(function () {
				$(this).slideUp();
				$('.family-site').removeClass('active');
				$('.family-area').removeClass('on');
				$('.family-area').attr('aria-expanded', false);
			});
		}

		// =================================
		// Talk 설정
		// =================================
		function evtFloatingPopup() {
			$popupService.cmnPopOkkytalk($scope);
		}

		// =================================
		// PAGE 이동
		// =================================
		function evtCommonMoveToPage(url, param) {

			if (url) {

				if (url.indexOf('http:/') >= 0 || url.indexOf('https:/') >= 0) {
					window.open(url, '_blank');
				} else {
					$utilService.go(url, param);
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================
		// 엔터 이벤트 처리
		// =================================
		function evtEnterClick(e) {
			var keyCode = e.which || e.keyCode;

			if (keyCode === 13) {
				evtCustFaq();
			}
		}

		// =================================	
		// 전체메뉴 MAP 형태 변환
		// =================================
		function renewalTotMenuConvertToMap(data, pMenuData) {

			var menuData = pMenuData;
			var menuList = [];
			var menuMap = {};

			if (data) {

				$.each(menuData, function (menuIdx) {

					$.each(data, function (idx) {

						if (menuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'] == data[idx]['menuCd']) {
							menuList.push(data[idx]);
						}
					});
				});

				$.each(data, function (idx) {

					if (!data[idx]['subList']) {
						data[idx]['subList'] = [];
					}

					if (menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]) {
						menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]['subList'].push(data[idx]);
					}

					menuMap[data[idx].menuCd] = data[idx];
				});
			}

			return menuList;
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시 하위에 첫번째 url이 걸린 menuCd 반환.
		// ====================================	
		function getFirstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
			var resultMenuCd = '';

			var firstMenuCd = function firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
				var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCd];
				var preIdx = 0;

				for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo['subMenuList'].length; i++) {

					if ($scope.allMenuList[menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd]['subMenuList'].length) {
						firstMenuCd(menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd);
					}

					if (!resultMenuCd) {
						if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].leafYn === 'Y' && menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuUrl) {
							resultMenuCd = menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			};

			firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd);

			return resultMenuCd;
		};

		// #####################################################################
		// 상품안내
		// #####################################################################


		// =================================
		// OK 맞춤 상품 조회
		// =================================
		function searchProduct(step) {

			var noneSeachHtml = '';

			noneSeachHtml = noneSeachHtml + '<div class="not-result">';
			noneSeachHtml = noneSeachHtml + '	<button type="button" class="btn-re-select">다시선택</button>';
			noneSeachHtml = noneSeachHtml + '</div>';

			if (Number(step) < 2) {
				return;
			}

			// 대출상품 조회
			if ($scope.slctGubn == 'lon') {

				$scope.data.slctCdsList = getSlctCdsList();

				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SLonMainMang2', operation: 'getMdorLonGdsMpngList' })).then(function (data) {

					var addHtml = '';

					if (data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto && data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto.sub) {
						$scope.listCnt = data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto.sub.length;
						$scope.mdorGdsList = data.SMaMdorGdsMpng01OutDto.sub;

						if ($scope.listCnt > 0) {

							$('#lon_product_content').html('');
							$('#deposit_product_content').html('');

							addHtml = addHtml + '<div class="result-card-slide">';

							$.each($scope.mdorGdsList, function (idx) {

								addHtml = addHtml + '	<div class="slide-cont">';
								addHtml = addHtml + '		<h4>' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['gdsNm'] + '</h4>';
								addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt1">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['smryCont'] + '</p>';

								if ($scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] == '0' || $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lonHghsAmt'] == '0') {
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last">한도<span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m"> 상품참조</span></span></p>';
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2">금리<span class="ff-apro-m"> 상품참조</span></p>';
									//			    				addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2"> <span class="ff-apro-m"> </span></p>';
								} else if ($scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] == $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['hghsRti']) {
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last">최대 <span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lonHghsAmt'] + '</span>만원</span></p>';
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2">연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
									//	    	    				addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2"> <span class="ff-apro-m"> </span></p>';
								} else {
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last">최대 <span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lonHghsAmt'] + '</span>만원</span></p>';
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2">최저 연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
									addHtml = addHtml + '		<p class="txt2">최고 연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['hghsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
								}

								addHtml = addHtml + '		<a href="javascript:;" data-idx="' + idx + '" title="' + $scope.mdorGdsList[idx]['gdsNm'] + ' 신청하기">신청</a>';
								addHtml = addHtml + '	</div>';
							});

							addHtml = addHtml + '</div>';

							var addHtml2 = '';
							addHtml2 = '고객님께  맞는 대출 상품이 검색되었습니다.';

							$('div.product-result-layer.prl1 > div.result-layer-top > p.top-txt').html(addHtml2);

							$('#lon_product_content').html(addHtml);

							// 상품안내 결과 슬라이드
							$('.result-card-slide').slick({
								slidesToShow: $scope.listCnt,
								infinite: false,
								slideWidth: 320,
								swipe: false
							});

							// 신청버튼 클릭 이벤트
							$('.product-result-layer.prl1').find('.slide-cont > a').on('click', function () {
								var dataIdx = Number($(this).data('idx'));
								var menuUrl = $scope.mdorGdsList[dataIdx]['menuUrl'];
								var menuCd = $scope.mdorGdsList[dataIdx]['menuCd'];
								var lonGdsSqno = $scope.mdorGdsList[dataIdx]['lonGdsSqno'];

								evtLonLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, lonGdsSqno);
							});
						} else {

							$('div.product-result-layer.prl1 > div.result-layer-top > p.top-txt').text('검색된 상품이 없습니다.');

							$('#lon_product_content').html('');
							$('#lon_product_content').html(noneSeachHtml);

							// 다시선택 버튼 클릭
							$('.btn-re-select').on('click', function () {
								$('.btn-close-layer').trigger('click');
							});
						}
					} else {

						$('div.product-result-layer.prl1 > div.result-layer-top > p.top-txt').text('검색된 상품이 없습니다.');

						$('#lon_product_content').html('');
						$('#lon_product_content').html(noneSeachHtml);

						// 다시선택 버튼 클릭
						$('.btn-re-select').on('click', function () {
							$('.btn-close-layer').trigger('click');
						});
					}
				});

				$scope.data.slctCdsList = null;

				// 예/적금 상품 조회
			} else if ($scope.slctGubn == 'deposit') {

				$scope.depsData = {
					chnlDvcd: 'H',
					mdorTp: $scope.slctCdsListDeposit[0],
					mdorTrTp: $scope.slctCdsListDeposit[1]
				};

				$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.depsData, { service: 'SLonMainMang2', operation: 'getMdorDepsGdsMpngList' })).then(function (data) {

					var depsAddHtml = '';

					if (data.SMaMdorDepsGdsMpng01OutDto && data.SMaMdorDepsGdsMpng01OutDto.sub) {
						$scope.depsListCnt = data.SMaMdorDepsGdsMpng01OutDto.sub.length;
						$scope.mdorDepsGdsList = data.SMaMdorDepsGdsMpng01OutDto.sub;

						if ($scope.depsListCnt > 0) {

							$('#lon_product_content').html('');
							$('#deposit_product_content').html('');

							depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '<div class="result-card-slide">';

							$.each($scope.mdorDepsGdsList, function (idx) {

								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '	<div class="slide-cont">';
								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<h4>' + $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['gdsNm'] + '</h4>';
								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt1">' + $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['smryCont'] + '</p>';

								if ($scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] == '0') {
									depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2">금리<span class="ff-apro-m"> 상품참조</span></p>';
									//	    						depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2"><span class="ff-apro-m"> </span></p>';
								} else if ($scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] == $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['hghsRti']) {
									depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2">연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
									//	    	    				depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2"><span class="ff-apro-m"> </span></p>';
								} else {
									depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2">최저 연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['lowsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
									depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2">최고 연 <span class="ff-apro-m">' + $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['hghsRti'] + '%</span></p>';
								}

								if ($scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['intrTp'] == '00002') {
									depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last">유형 <span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m"></span>변동금리</span></p>';
								} else if ($scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['intrTp'] == '00001') {
									depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last">유형 <span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m"></span>고정금리</span></p>';
								}
								//			    			else {
								//			    				depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<p class="txt2 txt-last"> <span class="txt-money"><span class="ff-apro-m"></span></span></p>';
								//			    			}

								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '		<a href="javascript:;" data-idx="' + idx + '" title="' + $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[idx]['gdsNm'] + ' 가입하기">가입</a>';
								depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '	</div>';
							});

							depsAddHtml = depsAddHtml + '</div>';

							$('div.product-result-layer.prl2 > div.result-layer-top > p.top-txt').html('고객님께 딱 맞는 예&middot;적금 상품이 검색되었습니다.');

							$('#deposit_product_content').html(depsAddHtml);

							// 상품안내 결과 슬라이드
							$('.result-card-slide').slick({
								slidesToShow: $scope.depsListCnt,
								infinite: false,
								slideWidth: 320,
								swipe: false
							});

							// 가입버튼 클릭 이벤트
							$('.product-result-layer.prl2').find('.slide-cont > a').on('click', function () {
								var dataIdx = Number($(this).data('idx'));
								var menuUrl = $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[dataIdx]['menuUrl'];
								var menuCd = $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[dataIdx]['menuCd'];
								var depsGdsSqno = $scope.mdorDepsGdsList[dataIdx]['depsGdsSqno'];

								evtDepsLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, depsGdsSqno);
							});
						} else {

							$('div.product-result-layer.prl2 > div.result-layer-top > p.top-txt').text('검색된 상품이 없습니다.');

							$('#deposit_product_content').html('');
							$('#deposit_product_content').html(noneSeachHtml);

							$('.btn-re-select').on('click', function () {
								$('.btn-close-layer').trigger('click');
							});
						}
					} else {

						$('div.product-result-layer.prl2 > div.result-layer-top > p.top-txt').text('검색된 상품이 없습니다.');

						$('#deposit_product_content').html('');
						$('#deposit_product_content').html(noneSeachHtml);

						$('.btn-re-select').on('click', function () {
							$('.btn-close-layer').trigger('click');
						});
					}
				});
			}
		}

		function getSlctCdsList() {

			var strResult = '';
			var comma = ',';
			var maxLength = $scope.slctCdsList.length - 1;

			var result = new Array();

			$.each($scope.slctCdsList, function (idx) {

				if (idx < maxLength) {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx] + comma;
				} else {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx];
				}
			});

			result.push(strResult);

			return result;
		}

		// =================================
		// 상품추천 결과 레이어 신청 버튼
		// =================================
		function evtLonLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, lonGdsSqno) {

			if (menuUrl) {
				if (menuCd) {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { 'menuCd': menuCd, 'lonGdsSqno': lonGdsSqno });
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl);
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================
		// 상품추천 결과 레이어 신청 버튼
		// =================================
		function evtDepsLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, depsGdsSqno) {

			if (menuUrl) {
				if (menuCd) {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { 'menuCd': menuCd, 'depsGdsSqno': depsGdsSqno });
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl);
				}
			}
		}

		function evtGoOpenPage(arrIndex) {

			var index = Number(arrIndex);

		}

		// =================================
		// 더보기 버튼 이벤트
		// =================================
		function evtMoreBtnClick(gubn) {
			var url = null;
			var param = null;
			// 보도자료
			if (gubn == 'pressRelease') {
				url = '/bankPbrlNwsList';
				param = {};

				// 공지사항	
			} else if (gubn == 'notice') {
				url = '/custNwsList';
				param = {};
			}

			$utilService.go(url, param);

		function getSearchList(data) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(data, { service: 'SGdsDepsMang', operation: 'getMaGdsDepsList' })).then(function (data) {
				if (data.SMaGdsDeps01OutDto.sub) {
					$scope.data.totalCount = data.SMaGdsDeps01OutDto.totalCount; // 총 건수 세팅

					$scope.selectObject = data.SMaGdsDeps01OutDto.sub;

					$.each($scope.selectObject, function (key) {
						if ($scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt != null) {
							var etryLowsAmt = $scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt.toString();
							if (etryLowsAmt >= 10000) {
								$scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt = etryLowsAmt.substr(0, etryLowsAmt.length - 4) + "만원";
							} else {
								$scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt = etryLowsAmt + "원";
							}
						}
					});
				}

				if ($scope.data.mngmTr == "") {
					$scope.data.mngmTr = '00000';
				}
				if ($scope.data.inrtTp == "") {
					$scope.data.inrtTp = '00000';
				}
				if ($scope.data.etryMthd == "") {
					$scope.data.etryMthd = '00000';

					$scope.data.entrObjc = '00000';
				}
			});
		}

		function evtGoPage2(title, location, url, param) {
			if (title) {
				setTitle(title);
			}
			if (location) {
				setLocation(location);
			}
			if (param) {
				$utilService.go(url, param);
			} else {
				$utilService.go(url);
			}
		}

		function setTitle(title) {
			$rootScope.title = title;
		}

		function setLocation(location) {
			if (!$rootScope['location']) {
				$rootScope['location'] = new Array(4);
			}
			if (location.indexOf('>') != -1) {
				var locationArray = location.split('>');
				$.each(locationArray, function (idx) {
					$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: locationArray[idx] };
				});
			}
		}

		function evtSnsShare(tp, no) {
			var snsShareUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/#" + $scope.data.url + "?depsGdsSqno=" + no + "&menuCd=" + $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');

		function evtBtCheck(m, n) {
			if (n) {
				if (m == "data.mngmTr") {
					$scope.data.mngmTrBk = $scope.data.mngmTr;
				}
				if (m == "data.inrtTp") {
					$scope.data.inrtTpBk = $scope.data.inrtTp;
				}
				if (m == "data.etryMthd") {
					$scope.data.etryMthdBk = $scope.data.etryMthd;
				}
				if (m == "data.acmlMthd") {
					$scope.data.acmlMthdBk = $scope.data.acmlMthd;
				}
				if (m == "data.entrObjc") {
					$scope.data.entrObjcBk = $scope.data.entrObjc;
				}
			} else {
				if (m == "data.mngmTr") {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.mngmTrData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.mngmTrData, $scope.data.mngmTrBk);
					});
				}
				if (m == "data.inrtTp") {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.inrtTpData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.inrtTpData, $scope.data.inrtTpBk);
					});
				}
				if (m == "data.etryMthd") {
					if ($scope.etryMthdShow) {
						$timeout(function () {
							$scope.etryMthdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.etryMthdData, $scope.data.etryMthdBk);
						});
					} else {
						$timeout(function () {
							$scope.frdmEtryMthdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.frdmEtryMthdData, $scope.data.etryMthdBk);
						});
					}
				}
				if (m == "data.acmlMthd") {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.acmlMthdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.acmlMthdData, $scope.data.acmlMthdBk);
					});
				}
				if (m == "data.entrObjc") {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.entrObjcData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.entrObjcData, $scope.data.entrObjcBk);
					});
				}
			}
		}

			if (keyCode === 13) {
				evtSrcClick();
			}
		}

	}

			// ==================================================================
			// rest 서비스 호출

				if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto) {
					console.log("####### data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto.concGdsList.length", data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto.concGdsList.length);

					if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto.stsCd != '00002') {

						return;
					}

					//관련상품
					if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto.concGdsList.length > 0) {
						$scope.view.concGdsList = true;

					}

								//상품정보/유의사항 탭
								if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key]) {

										switch (key2) {
											case 'title1':

												break;
											case 'buttom1':
												$scope.data[key][key2] = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][key2] ? data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][key2] : '';
												break;
											default:
												$scope.data[key][key2] = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][key2];
												break;

										}
									});
								}
								break;
							case 'inrtNrmlGdList':
								//정상금리

									$scope.smsCuwNo = '20285';
								}

								$scope.data[key] = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key];

							default:
								$scope.data[key] = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key];
						}
					});

					// 내집으로OK론 대출신청하기 버튼 url 세팅
					if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['bspGdsCd'] == 'P700190080') {
						$scope.data['pcCunsUrl'] = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['pcLmtUrl'];
					}

					//대출센터일 경우 상담신청 url은 한도조회 url로 셋팅
					if (!$scope.homeFlag) {
						$scope.data['pcCunsUrl'] = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['pcLmtUrl'];
					}

					//금액단위 설정 여신기획팀 김영형 대리님 - 억원 추가 요청
					//디지털채널팀 류다혜대리님 - PF대출만 억원 나오게 해달라고 요청
					$scope.data['lonHghsAmt2'] = 0;
					if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['bspGdsCd'] == 'P700190155') {
						$scope.data['lonHghsAmt2'] = Number(data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['lonHghsAmt'].toString().slice(0, -4));
					}

					// 111론 고정된 금액, 금리 나오게 변경 / 소비자금융기획팀 한은지 과장님 요청
					$scope.data['lonHghsAmt111'] = 0;
					$scope.data['lowsRti111'] = 0;
					if (data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto['bspGdsCd'] == '0201001100') {
						$scope.data['lonHghsAmt111'] = 1;
						$scope.data['lowsRti111'] = 1;

						$scope.cunsBtnActvYn = 'N'; // 대출신청버튼 숨김
					}

					// 홈페이지 관리자페이지 금리정보 표기방식 변경 (SR_317583)
					if (Number($scope.data['hghsRti']) > 0 && Number($scope.data['hghsRti']) == Number($scope.data['lowsRti'])) {
						$scope.data['lowsRti111'] = '1';
					}
				}
			});
		}

		//관련상품이동
		function evtMoveToPage(concTp, concSqno, menuCd, menuUrl) {
			if (concTp) {
				if (menuCd == $scope.data.menuCd) {
					var param = { lonGdsSqno: concSqno, menuCd: menuCd };

					$scope.data.lonGdsSqno = concSqno;
					$scope.data['etryLowsAmt'] = 0;

					evtSrcClick();
					$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
					param = $.extend(true, $location.$$search ? $location.$$search : {}, param);

					$utilService.go(menuUrl, param, $scope, function () {
						evtSrcClick();
						$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
					});
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { lonGdsSqno: concSqno, menuCd: menuCd });
				}
			} else {
				var key = {
					menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
					pageNo: $utilService.getParamVal('pageNo'),
					lonHghsAmt: $utilService.getParamVal('lonHghsAmt'),
					lonAmtSrchCd: $utilService.getParamVal('lonAmtSrchCd'),
					rfndMetdCd: $utilService.getParamVal('rfndMetdCd'),
					rqusObjcCd: $utilService.getParamVal('rqusObjcCd'),
					charTagCd: $utilService.getParamVal('charTagCd'),
					arayGdsNm: $utilService.getParamVal('arayGdsNm'),
					arayInrt: $utilService.getParamVal('arayInrt')
				};

				$utilService.go($scope.data.page, key);
			}
		}

		// 페이지 이동
		function evtMoveToPage2(type) {
			console.log($scope.data);
			var param = { lonGdsSqno: $scope.data.lonGdsSqno, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd };
			var page = '';

			var brfGdsInfo = $scope.data.brfGdsInfo;
			if (brfGdsInfo && brfGdsInfo.srvcYn == 'N') {
				var srvcMsg = brfGdsInfo.srvcMsg || "상품 이용 가능 시간이 아닙니다.<br>(" + brfGdsInfo.srvcStrt + "~" + brfGdsInfo.srvcEnd + ")";
				$utilService.openAlert(srvcMsg, function () {
					$utilService.go($scope.data.page);
				});
				return;
			}

			switch (type) {
				case 'A':
					//한도조회
					page = $scope.data.pcLmtUrl;
					break;
				case 'B':
					//상담신청
					if ($scope.okStockLonFlag) {
						//스탁OK론일 경우
						window.open('https://stock.oksavingsbank.com/stock', '_blank');
					} else if ($scope.onlnSnsnLonFlag && $scope.data.mblwCunsUrl != null && $scope.data.mblwCunsUrl == "/gds_sun_lmt000") {
						//온라인햇살론일 경우
						$popupService.cmnPopOnlnSnsnChck($scope, function (data) {
							console.log("cmnPopOnlnSnsnChck data ", data);
						});
						return;
					} else {
						page = $scope.data.pcCunsUrl;
						param.gdsClsnCd = $scope.data.gdsClsnCd; // 상품구분코드
						param.gdsCd = $scope.data.gdsCd; // 상품코드
						param.bspGdsCd = $scope.data.bspGdsCd; // 대출상품코드
						param.gdsNm = $scope.data.gdsNm; // 대출상품명
						param.clbcDtlDetlPathCd = $scope.data.cunsTpCd; // 초간편용 : 상담신청코드			  
					}
					break;
			}

			$utilService.go(page, param);
		}

		function evtCopyUrl() {

		// url치환 function
		function urlVaild(data, key) {

			for (var i = 0; i < data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key].length; i++) {
				var tempInfoMap = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i];
				var contRst = tempInfoMap.cont.replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
				var urlSrh = tempInfoMap.cont.match(/@.*?@/g);
				if (urlSrh) {
					var redirectUrl = urlSrh[0].match(/\(.*?\)/g);
					redirectUrl = redirectUrl[0].replace(/\(|\)/g, "");
					var urlName = urlSrh[0].replace("(" + redirectUrl + ")", "");

					//모바일url과 홈페이지 url 이 달라 정상로드되지 않는경우 
					if ("/#/bank_bsbr_gd" == redirectUrl) {
						//영업점안내
						redirectUrl = "/#/bankBsbrGd";
					}

					urlName = "<a href =" + redirectUrl + " target=\"_blank\" title=\"새창열림\">" + urlName + "</a>";
					data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i].cont = contRst.replace(urlSrh, urlName).replace(/@/g, "");
				} else {
					data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i].cont = contRst;
				}
			}
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;

	/* @ngInject */
	function __controller($scope, $state, $stateParams, $commonService, $utilService, $timeout) {

		/*통합검색*/
		// ==================================================================
		// set scope parameter
		// ==================================================================
		$scope.data = {
			srchNm: '',
			srchObjcCd: '0',
			srchNmAft: '제목 또는 내용',
			totalCount: 0,
			wrkReslNcnt1: 0,
			wrkReslNcnt2: 0,
			wrkReslNcnt3: 0,
			wrkReslNcnt4: 0,
			wrkReslNcnt5: 0
		};

		console.log("#### location.href.search('/#')", location.href.search('/#'));

		$scope.srchObjcTmpData1 = {};
		$scope.srchObjcTmpData2 = {};
		$scope.srchObjcTmpData3 = {};
		$scope.srchObjcTmpData4 = {};
		$scope.srchObjcTmpData5 = {};

		//데이터 set
		//$.each($scope.srchObjcCdData, function(val, key) {


		$scope.show = { objc1: true, objc2: true, objc3: true, objc4: true, objc5: true };
		$scope.exdata = { objc1: false, objc2: false, objc3: false, objc4: false, objc5: false };
		$scope.nexdata = { objc1: true, objc2: true, objc3: true, objc4: true, objc5: true };

		// ==================================================================
		// set event listener
		// ==================================================================
		$scope.event = {
			init: evtInit,
			srchClick: evtSrchClick,
			tabClick: evtTabClick,
			enterClick: evtEnterClick //input 엔터시 이벤트 함수 호출
			, moveToPage: evtMoveToPage
		};

		//검색대상카테고리 설정
		$scope.srchObjcCdData = [{ label: '전체 (0)', value: '0' }, { label: '예금상품 (0)', value: '1' }, { label: '대출상품 (0)', value: '2' }, { label: '공지사항 및 뉴스 (0)', value: '3' }, { label: '자주하는 질문 (0)', value: '4' }, { label: '서식 및 약관 (0)', value: '5' }, { label: '금융소비자보호 (0)', value: '6' }];

		// ==================================================================

		// 화면 초기화 function
		function evtInit() {

			$scope.data.srchNm = $utilService.getParamVal('srchNm') || '';

			//검색
			$scope.srchObjcCdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.srchObjcCdData, $scope.data.srchObjcCd);

			$commonService.getCmnCdSubList('HC0223', function (data) {

				$scope.slctCdData = data['HC0223'] || [];

				if ($scope.data.srchNm) {
					evtSrchClick();
				}
			});
		}

		// ==================================================================
		// 사용자 지정 콜백 함수
		// ==================================================================	
		function evtSrchClick() {

			if ($scope.data.srchNm.length <= 0) {
				$utilService.openAlert('검색어를 입력해주세요.');
				$('srchNm').focus();
				return;
			}

			//검색카테고리를 전체로 변경
			$scope.data.srchObjcCd = '0';

			// ==================================================================
			// rest 서비스 호출
			// ==================================================================
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SCmnIntrSrch', operation: 'getCmnIntrSrchList' })).then(function (data) {

				if (data.SCmnIntrSrch01OutDto) {

					//검색어
					$scope.data.srchNmAft = $scope.data.srchNm;

					//데이터 set
					$.each($scope.srchObjcCdData, function (val, key) {

						//검색건수 설정
						if (val == 0) {
							$scope.data.totalCount = data.SCmnIntrSrch01OutDto.totalCount;
						} else {
							$scope.data['wrkReslNcnt' + val] = data.SCmnIntrSrch01OutDto['wrkReslNcnt' + val];

							//검색결과 Title show/hide
							$scope.show['objc' + val] = true;

							//검색결과건수별 세부항목 show/hide
							if ($scope.data['wrkReslNcnt' + val] > 0) {
								$scope.exdata['objc' + val] = true;
								$scope.nexdata['objc' + val] = false;

								//조회결과 임시저장
								$scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val] = data.SCmnIntrSrch01OutDto['sub' + val];

								console.log("### $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val]", $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val]);

								//초기 조회결과 설정(최대 3건)
								if ($scope.data['wrkReslNcnt' + val] > 3) {
									$scope['selectObject' + val] = [{ srchReslNm: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchReslNm,
										srchReslCont: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchReslCont,
										menuCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].menuCd,
										url: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].url,
										srchSqno: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchSqno,
										srchSlctCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchSlctCd || '',
										srchMastBrdNo: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchMastBrdNo || ''
									}, { srchReslNm: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchReslNm,
										srchReslCont: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchReslCont,
										menuCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].menuCd,
										url: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].url,
										srchSqno: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchSqno,
										srchSlctCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchSlctCd || '',
										srchMastBrdNo: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchMastBrdNo || ''
									}, { srchReslNm: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchReslNm,
										srchReslCont: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchReslCont,
										menuCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].menuCd,
										url: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].url,

										srchSlctCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchSlctCd || '',
										srchMastBrdNo: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchMastBrdNo || ''
									}];
								} else {
									$scope['selectObject' + val] = $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val];
								}
							} else {
								$scope.exdata['objc' + val] = false;
								$scope.nexdata['objc' + val] = true;
							}
						}
					});

					$scope.srchObjcCdData = [{ label: '전체 (            ' + $scope.data.totalCount + ')', value: '0' }, { label: '예금상품 (' + $scope.data.wrkReslNcnt1 + ')', value: '1' }, { label: '대출상품 (' + $scope.data.wrkReslNcnt2 + ')', value: '2' }, { label: '공지사항 및 뉴스 (' + $scope.data.wrkReslNcnt3 + ')', value: '3' }, { label: '자주하는 질문 (' + $scope.data.wrkReslNcnt4 + ')', value: '4' }, { label: '서식 및 약관 (' + $scope.data.wrkReslNcnt5 + ')', value: '5' }, { label: '금융소비자보호 (' + $scope.data.wrkReslNcnt6 + ')', value: '6' }];

					$scope.srchObjcCdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.srchObjcCdData, $scope.data.srchObjcCd);
				}
			});
		}

		//카테고리 탭클릭시
		function evtTabClick(objcCdNum) {

			if (objcCdNum != null) {
				$scope.data.srchObjcCd = objcCdNum;
			}

			$.each($scope.srchObjcCdData, function (val, key) {
				if (val != '0') {
					if ($scope.data.srchObjcCd == '0') {
						$scope.show['objc' + val] = true;

						//전체보기시 각항목 3건씩 출력
						if ($scope.data['wrkReslNcnt' + val] > 3) {
							$scope['selectObject' + val] = [{ srchReslNm: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchReslNm,
								srchReslCont: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchReslCont,
								srchSlctCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchSlctCd || '',
								srchSqno: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchSqno,
								srchMastBrdNo: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][0].srchMastBrdNo || ''
							}, { srchReslNm: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchReslNm,
								srchReslCont: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchReslCont,
								srchSlctCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchSlctCd || '',
								srchSqno: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchSqno,
								srchMastBrdNo: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][1].srchMastBrdNo || ''
							}, { srchReslNm: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchReslNm,
								srchReslCont: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchReslCont,
								srchSlctCd: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchSlctCd || '',
								srchSqno: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchSqno,
								srchMastBrdNo: $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val][2].srchMastBrdNo || ''
							}];
						} else {
							$scope['selectObject' + val] = $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val];
						}
						$('a.srh-link.more').show();
					} else {
						if ($scope.data.srchObjcCd == val) {
							$scope.show['objc' + val] = true;

							//더보기/탭클릭시 리스트전체 보기
							$scope['selectObject' + val] = $scope['srchObjcTmpData1' + val];
						} else {
							$scope.show['objc' + val] = false;
						}
						$('a.srh-link.more').hide();
					}
				}
			});
		}

			}
		}

		// 링크페이지 이동
		function evtMoveToPage(type, page, param) {
			console.log("### move page", page);
			console.log("### move page param", param);

			//$utilService.go(page, param);
			var hasShap = location.href.search('/#/') > -1;
			if (type == '1') {
				window.open('about:blank').location.href = (hasShap ? '#' : '') + page + '?menuCd=' + param.menuCd + '&depsGdsSqno=' + param.depsGdsSqno;
			} else if (type == '2') {
				window.open('about:blank').location.href = (hasShap ? '#' : '') + page + '?menuCd=' + param.menuCd + '&lonGdsSqno=' + param.lonGdsSqno;
			} else if (type == '3') {
				window.open('about:blank').location.href = (hasShap ? '#' : '') + page + '?mastBrdNo=1&brdNo=' + param.brdNo;
			} else if (type == '5') {
				window.open('about:blank').location.href = (hasShap ? '#' : '') + page + '?srchMastBrdNo=' + param.srchMastBrdNo + '&srchBrdNo=' + param.srchSqno + '&srchSlctCd=' + param.srchSlctCd;
			} else {
				window.open('about:blank').location.href = (hasShap ? '#' : '') + page;
			}
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.event.init();
	}
