		// =================================	
		// 전체메뉴 MAP 형태 변환
		// =================================
		function renewalTotMenuConvertToMap(data, pMenuData) {

			var menuData = pMenuData;
			var menuList = [];
			var menuMap = {};

			if (data) {

				$.each(menuData, function (menuIdx) {

					$.each(data, function (idx) {

						if (menuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'] == data[idx]['menuCd']) {
							menuList.push(data[idx]);
						}
					});
				});

				$.each(data, function (idx) {

					if (!data[idx]['subList']) {
						data[idx]['subList'] = [];
					}

					if (menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]) {
						menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]['subList'].push(data[idx]);
					}

					menuMap[data[idx].menuCd] = data[idx];
				});
			}

			return menuList;
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시, 화면 이동
		// ====================================	
		function evtMoveToFirstPage(menuCd) {

			var headerMenuCd = '';
			var currMenuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[menuCd];

			if (currMenuInfo.menuLvl == 1 || currMenuInfo.menuLvl == 2) {
				headerMenuCd = currMenuInfo.menuCd;
			}

			var firstMenuCd = getFirstMenuCd(headerMenuCd);
			var firstMenuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[firstMenuCd];

			$utilService.go(firstMenuInfo.menuUrl, { menuCd: firstMenuInfo.menuCd });
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시 하위에 첫번째 url이 걸린 menuCd 반환.
		// ====================================	
		function getFirstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
			var resultMenuCd = '';

			var firstMenuCd = function firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
				var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCd];
				var preIdx = 0;

				for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo['subMenuList'].length; i++) {

					if ($scope.allMenuList[menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd]['subMenuList'].length) {
						firstMenuCd(menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd);
					}

					if (!resultMenuCd) {
						if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].leafYn === 'Y' && menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuUrl) {
							resultMenuCd = menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			};

			firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd);

			return resultMenuCd;
		};

		// =================================
		// GNB 메뉴 생성 호출
		// =================================
		function createGnbCall(menuUrl) {

			$timeout(function () {

				if ($('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb').length) {
					createGnbMenu(menuUrl);
				} else {
					createGnbCall(menuUrl);
				}
			}, 100);
		}

		// =================================	
		// GNB 메뉴 생성
		// =================================
		function createGnbMenu(menuUrl) {
			var menuCd = '';

			if ($scope.homeFlag) {
				convertSideMenuToMap($scope.orgTotHomeList);
			} else {
				convertSideMenuToMap($scope.orgTotLoanList);
			}

			if ($scope.lmenuList.length > 0) {

				if (menuUrl) {
					if ($scope.sideMenuUrlMap[menuUrl]) {
						menuCd = $scope.sideMenuUrlMap[menuUrl].menuCd;
					}
				}

				if (!menuCd) {
					var menuInfo = getDefaultMenuInfo();
					menuCd = menuInfo.menuCd;
				}

				if ($scope.allMenuList[menuCd].menuLvl != 1) {
					sideMenuReset(menuCd);
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================	
		// 메뉴정보목록을 메뉴 셋팅에 필요한 변수로 전환 
		// =================================
		function convertSideMenuToMap(data) {

			$scope.lmenuList = [];
			$scope.allMenuList = {};
			$scope.sideMenuUrlMap = {};

			if (data == undefined) {
				data = $scope.orgTotHomeList;
			}

			$.each(data, function (idx) {
				var sideKey = getSideMenuUrlMap(data[idx].menuUrl);

				if (data[idx].menuUrl && !$scope.sideMenuUrlMap[sideKey]) {
					$scope.sideMenuUrlMap[sideKey] = data[idx];
				}

				if (data[idx].menuLvl == 1) {
					$scope.lmenuList.push(data[idx]);
				}

				if (data[idx].menuLvl == 3) {
					data[idx].leafYn = 'Y';
				}

				if (!$scope.allMenuList[data[idx].menuCd]) {
					$scope.allMenuList[data[idx].menuCd] = data[idx];
					$scope.allMenuList[data[idx].menuCd]['subMenuList'] = [];
				}

				if ($scope.allMenuList[data[idx].parentMenuCd]) {
					if ($scope.allMenuList[data[idx].parentMenuCd].leafYn !== 'Y') {
						$scope.allMenuList[data[idx].parentMenuCd]['subMenuList'].push(data[idx]);
					}
				}
			});

			$.each($scope.siteMapMenuData, function (menuIdx) {

				$.each(data, function (idx) {

					if ($scope.siteMapMenuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'] == data[idx]['menuCd']) {
						console.log($scope.siteMapMenuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'], ' , ', data[idx]['menuCd']);

						$scope.lmenuList.push(data[idx]);
					}
				});
			});
		}

		// =================================	
		// 메뉴 맵키 반환
		// =================================
		function getSideMenuUrlMap(menuUrl) {
			var key = '';

			if (menuUrl) {
				menuUrl = menuUrl.toLocaleLowerCase();
				if (menuUrl.indexOf('/gdslon') == 0) {
					menuUrl = menuUrl.replace('gdslon', '');
				}

				if (menuUrl.indexOf('/snsn') == 0) {
					// 햇살론 
					menuUrl = '/sdst';
				}

				if (menuUrl.indexOf('/hs') == 0) {
					menuUrl = '/mgglmt';
				}

				key = menuUrl.replace(/(list|dtl|[0-9]{3,5}[_]{0,1}[a-zA-Z]{0,9}_cnsl[0-9]{0,2}|[0-9]{3,5}[_]{0,1}[a-zA-Z]{0,9})$/, '');
			}

			return key;
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 첫 init때 메뉴 셋팅 정보 반환
		// ====================================	
		function getDefaultMenuInfo() {
			var current = $state.current;

			return $scope.sideMenuUrlMap[getSideMenuUrlMap(current.url)] ? $scope.sideMenuUrlMap[getSideMenuUrlMap(current.url)] : $scope.lmenuList[0];
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 사이드 메뉴 생성
		// ====================================	
		function sideMenuReset(menuCd, firstFlag) {
			var headerMenuCd = '';
			var parentMenuCds = [];
			var currMenuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[menuCd];

			if (currMenuInfo.menuLvl == 1) {
				headerMenuCd = currMenuInfo.menuCd;

				for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
					setLocation(i, null);
				}
			} else {
				var parentMenuCds = [currMenuInfo.parentMenuCd];

				for (var i = currMenuInfo.menuLvl - 1; i > 1; i--) {
					var parentMenuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCds[parentMenuCds.length - 1]];
					parentMenuCds.push(parentMenuInfo.parentMenuCd);
				}

				headerMenuCd = parentMenuCds[parentMenuCds.length - 1];
			}

			$.each($scope.lmenuList, function (idx) {

				if (headerMenuCd === $scope.lmenuList[idx].menuCd) {
					$scope.lmenuList[idx]['classNm'] = 'on';

					//    			if ($scope.homeFlag) {
					//    				setLocation(0, "HOME");
					//    			} else {
					//    				setLocation(0, "대출센터");
					//    			}
					setLocation(0, "HOME");

					setLocation($scope.lmenuList[idx].menuLvl, $scope.lmenuList[idx].menuNm);
				} else {
					$scope.lmenuList[idx]['classNm'] = '';
				}
			});

			if (parentMenuCds.length > 0) {

				for (var i = 1; i <= parentMenuCds.length; i++) {
					var parentMenuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCds[parentMenuCds.length - i]];

					if (parentMenuInfo.menuLvl == 1) {
						addSubMenu(parentMenuInfo.menuCd);
					} else {
						addSubMenu(parentMenuInfo.parentMenuCd, $('#' + parentMenuInfo.parentMenuCd));
					}

					if (parentMenuCds.length == 1) {
						setClickEvent('B', $('#' + currMenuInfo.menuCd), firstFlag ? false : true);
						$('#' + currMenuInfo.menuCd).trigger('click');
						setClickEvent('B', $('#' + currMenuInfo.menuCd));
					} else {
						setClickEvent('B', $('#' + parentMenuInfo.menuCd), firstFlag ? false : true);
						$('#' + parentMenuInfo.menuCd).trigger('click');
						setClickEvent('B', $('#' + parentMenuInfo.menuCd));
					}
				}

				if (parentMenuCds.length > 1) {
					setClickEvent('A', $('#' + currMenuInfo.menuCd), firstFlag ? false : true);
					$('#' + currMenuInfo.menuCd).trigger('click');
					setClickEvent('A', $('#' + currMenuInfo.menuCd));
				}
			} else {
				addSubMenu(headerMenuCd);
				sideMenuReset(getFirstMenuCd(headerMenuCd), true);
			}
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 메뉴 코드에 대한 하위 메뉴 목록 셋팅
		// ====================================	
		function addSubMenu(menuCd, obj) {
			var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[menuCd];

			if (menuInfo.menuCd === '02637') {
				debugger;
			}

			if (obj) {

				if ($(obj).find('button').length) {

					if (!$(obj).find('ul').length) {
						$(obj).append('<ul></ul>');

						$.each(menuInfo['subMenuList'], function (idx) {

							//if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuCd != '02812') {
							$(obj).children('ul').append('<li id="' + menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuCd + '"><a href="javascript:;" title="' + (menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].otsdUrl ? '새창연결' : '이동') + '">' + menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuNm + '</a></li>');
							$(obj).children('ul').find('li').last().data('info', menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx]);
							//}
						});

						setClickEvent('A', $(obj).find('ul>li'), false);
					}
				}
			} else {

				$('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb').html('<h2>' + menuInfo.menuNm + '</h2>');
				//$('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb').append('<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="document.getElementById(\'content_wrap\').tabIndex=\'0\';document.getElementById(\'content_wrap\').focus();" style="display:block;height:1px;width:1px;overflow:hidden;">본문으로 건너뛰기</a>');
				$('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb').append('<ul></ul>');

				$.each(menuInfo['subMenuList'], function (idx) {

					//if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuCd != '02855') {

					if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].leafYn === 'Y') {
						$('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb').find('ul').append('<li id="' + menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuCd + '"><a href="javascript:;" title="' + (menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].otsdUrl ? '새창연결' : '이동') + '">' + menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuNm + '</a></li>');
					} else {
						$('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb').find('ul').append('<li class="has-list" id="' + menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuCd + '"><button type="button">' + menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx].menuNm + '</button></li>');
					}

					$('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb').find('ul').find('li').last().data('info', menuInfo['subMenuList'][idx]);
					//}
				});

				setClickEvent('B', $('div.lnb-wrap>.lnb>ul>li'), false);
			}
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시 하위에 첫번째 url이 걸린 menuCd 반환.
		// ====================================	
		function getFirstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
			var resultMenuCd = '';

			var firstMenuCd = function firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
				var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCd];
				var preIdx = 0;

				for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo['subMenuList'].length; i++) {

					if ($scope.allMenuList[menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd]['subMenuList'].length) {
						firstMenuCd(menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd);
					}

					if (!resultMenuCd) {
						if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].leafYn === 'Y' && menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuUrl) {
							resultMenuCd = menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			};

			firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd);

			return resultMenuCd;
		};

		// ====================================	
		// 사이드 메뉴 클릭
		// ====================================	
		function setClickEvent(type, obj, initFlag) {
			obj.unbind('click');

			if (type === 'A') {

				obj.bind('click', function (e) {
					e.stopPropagation();

					$(this).addClass('sub-on').siblings().removeClass('sub-on');

					setLocation($(this).data('info').menuLvl, $(this).data('info').menuNm);

					if ($(this).data('info').leafYn === 'Y') {

						if ($(this).data('info').otsdUrl) {
							if (!initFlag) {
								window.open($(this).data('info').otsdUrl, '_blank');
							}
						} else if ($(this).data('info').menuUrl) {

							setTitle($(this).data('info').menuNm);

							if ($(this).data('info').menuLvl == 2) {
								setLocation(3, null);
							}

							if (!initFlag) {
								$utilService.go($(this).data('info').menuUrl, { menuCd: $(this).data('info').menuCd });
							}
						}
					} else {
						addSubMenu($(this).attr('id'), this);
					}
				});
			} else {

				obj.bind('click', function (e) {
					$(this).addClass('menu-on').siblings().removeClass('menu-on');
					$(this).siblings().removeClass('list-open');
					$(this).siblings().find('ul>li').removeClass('sub-on');

					if ($(this).find('button').length) {
						if (!$(this).hasClass('list-open')) {
							$(this).addClass('list-open').siblings().removeClass('list-open');
						} else {
							$(this).removeClass('list-open');
						}
					}

					setLocation($(this).data('info').menuLvl, $(this).data('info').menuNm);

					if ($(this).data('info').leafYn === 'Y') {

						if ($(this).data('info').otsdUrl) {
							if (!initFlag) {
								window.open($(this).data('info').otsdUrl, '_blank');
							}
						} else if ($(this).data('info').menuUrl) {
							setTitle($(this).data('info').menuNm);

							if ($(this).data('info').menuLvl == 2) {
								setLocation(3, null);
							}

							if (!initFlag) {
								$utilService.go($(this).data('info').menuUrl, { menuCd: $(this).data('info').menuCd });
							}
						}
					} else {
						addSubMenu($(this).attr('id'), this);
					}
				});
			}
		}

		// =================================	
		// Gid 타이틀 적용
		// =================================
		function setTitle(title) {
			$rootScope['title'] = title;
		}

		// =================================

		function setLocation(idx, menuNm) {

			if (!$rootScope['location']) {
				$rootScope['location'] = new Array(4);
			}

			$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: menuNm };
		}

		// =================================	
		// gnb 마우스 오버 이벤트
		// =================================
		function gnbHover() {

			$timeout(function () {

				$("#gnb > li > a").on('mouseenter focus', function () {
					var gnb_self = $(this).parent('li');

					$('#ok_header').addClass('gnb_active');
					gnb_self.addClass('active').siblings().removeClass('active');
					gnb_self.siblings().children('.gnb-cont').hide();
					$(this).next('.gnb-cont').show();

					if (gnb_self.find('.gnb-depth-cont.ng-scope').length > 8) {
						$('.ok-header').addClass('h_878');
					} else {
						$('.ok-header').removeClass('h_878');
					}
				});

				$(".ok-header").on('mouseleave', function () {
					$('#gnb .gnb-cont').hide();
					$('#ok_header').removeClass('gnb_active');
					$('.ok-header').removeClass('h_878');
				});

				$(".ok-header .btn-link-bank").on('focusout', function () {
					$('#gnb .gnb-cont').hide();
					$('#ok_header').removeClass('gnb_active');
					$('.ok-header').removeClass('h_878');
				});

				// 20210125 접근성 추가
				$("#gnb .gnb-cont .gnb-depth .gnb-depth-cont ul li a").on('click', function () {
					$('#gnb .gnb-cont').hide();
					$('#ok_header').removeClass('gnb_active');
					$('.ok-header').removeClass('h_878');
				});
			});
		}

		// =================================		
		// 클릭 메뉴 화면 이동
		// =================================	
		function moveToPageFun(menuInfo) {

			if (menuInfo.leafYn == 'Y' && menuInfo.menuUrl) {
				$utilService.go(menuInfo.menuUrl, { menuCd: menuInfo.menuCd });
			} else {
				if (menuInfo.subList.length) {
					for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo.subList.length; i++) {
						if (menuInfo.subList[i].menuUrl) {
							$utilService.go(menuInfo.subList[i].menuUrl, { menuCd: menuInfo.subList[i].menuCd });
							break;
						}
					}
				} else {
					if (menuInfo.otsdUrl.indexOf('http:/') >= 0 || menuInfo.otsdUrl.indexOf('https:/') >= 0) {
						window.open(menuInfo.otsdUrl, '_blank');
					}
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================

		function evtMoveToInternetBnaking() {

		}

		// =================================
		// HEADER BANNER PAGE 이동
		// =================================
		function evtBnrMoveToPage(url, param) {
			if (url) {
				if (url.indexOf('http:/') >= 0 || url.indexOf('https:/') >= 0) {
					window.open(url, '_blank');
				} else {
					if (url == "/cnsmFncDtntDclrCenr") {
						param = { menuCd: "00002" };
					}
					$utilService.go(url, param);
				}
			}
		}

		function evntDataCheck() {

		$scope.event.init();
		evntDataCheck();

		// 페이지 변경 시  현재 url 대메뉴 구조와 클릭된 url 대메뉴 구조가 다를 경우 변경되는 url 메뉴 구조로 변경을 위함.
		$utilService.setAllMenuReLoadFun(function (toState, formState, location, toParams, fromParams) {

			var flag = toState.url.indexOf('/main') == 0 || toState.url.indexOf('/lon/main') == 0;

			if (!flag && getSideMenuUrlMap(toState.url) != getSideMenuUrlMap(formState.url)) {

				var type = 0;

				if (formState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0 && !toState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0) {
					type = 1;
				} else if (!formState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0 && toState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0) {
					type = 2;
				} else if (formState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0 && toState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0) {
					type = 3;
				} else if (!formState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0 && !toState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0) {
					type = 3;
				}

				switch (type) {

					case 1:
						//전 플랫폼이 대출이고 이동 플랫폼이 홈일 경우
						$scope.homeFlag = true;
						evtInit(getSideMenuUrlMap(toState.url));
						break;

					case 2:
						//전 플랫폼이 홈이고 이동 폴랫폼이 대출일 경우
						$scope.homeFlag = false;
						evtInit(getSideMenuUrlMap(toState.url));
						break;

					case 3:
						//전,이동 플랫폼 동일 할 경우
						if (toState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0) {
							$scope.homeFlag = false;
						} else {
							$scope.homeFlag = true;
						}

						var menuInfo = $scope.sideMenuUrlMap[getSideMenuUrlMap(toState.url)];

						if (menuInfo) {
							sideMenuReset(menuInfo.menuCd);
						}

						break;
				}

				// 20210120 타이틀 추가			
				if (window.location.href === "https://www.oksavingbank.com/#/conts00000") {
					$(document).attr('title', '한도조회 - 한도조회결과 > 대출신청 > 대출 > OK저축은행');
				}
				if (window.location.href === "https://www.oksavingbank.com/#/lon/conts00200") {
					$(document).attr('title', '한도조회 - 대출신청 - 추가정보입력 > 대출신청 > 대출 > OK저축은행');
				}

				if (window.location.href === "https://www.oksavingbank.com/#/mbrEtryGd000") {
					$(document).attr('title', '멤버십소개/가입 - 약관동의 < 멤버십소개/가입 < OK멤버십 < OK저축은행');
				}

				if (window.location.href === "https://www.oksavingbank.com/#/mbrEtryGd000?menuCd=02449") {
					$(document).attr('title', '멤버십소개/가입 - 약관동의 < 멤버십소개/가입 < OK멤버십 < OK저축은행');
				}

				if (window.location.href === "https://www.oksavingbank.com/#/bankPbrlCf?menuCd=00355") {
					$('.cf-list .cf-img > img').attr('alt', ' ');
				}
			}
		});
	}

		};function pad2(n) {
			return (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n;
		}

		var d = new Date();
		var yymmddhhmiss = Number(d.getFullYear() + pad2(d.getMonth() + 1) + pad2(d.getDate()) + pad2(d.getHours()) + pad2(d.getMinutes()) + pad2(d.getSeconds()));

		};function evtInit() {

			// ---------------------------------
			// 전체메뉴 조회
			// ---------------------------------
			$commonService.getRenewalTotMenuMap(function (data) {

				if (data) {

					if (data['home']) {

						// 사이트맵 메뉴 데이터 담기
						$scope.totSiteMapList = renewalTotMenuConvertToMap(data['home'], $scope.siteMapMenuData);

							$.each($scope.headerMenuData, function (haderMenuIdx) {

		// =================================	
		// 전체메뉴 MAP 형태 변환
		// =================================
		function renewalTotMenuConvertToMap(data, pMenuData) {

			var menuData = pMenuData;
			var menuList = [];
			var menuMap = {};

			if (data) {

				$.each(menuData, function (menuIdx) {

					$.each(data, function (idx) {

						if (menuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'] == data[idx]['menuCd']) {
							menuList.push(data[idx]);
						}
					});
				});

				$.each(data, function (idx) {

					if (!data[idx]['subList']) {
						data[idx]['subList'] = [];
					}

					if (menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]) {
						menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]['subList'].push(data[idx]);
					}

					menuMap[data[idx].menuCd] = data[idx];
				});
			}

			return menuList;
		}

		function evntDataCheck() {
			initFactory.evntDataCheck(function (isFlag) {
				$scope.evntFlag = isFlag;
			});
		}

		// =================================	
		// GNB MOUSE OVER 이벤트
		// =================================
		function gnbHover() {

			$("#gnb > li > a").on('mouseenter focus', function () {
				var gnb_self = $(this).parent('li');

				$('#ok_header').addClass('gnb_active');
				gnb_self.addClass('active').siblings().removeClass('active');
				gnb_self.siblings().children('.gnb-cont').hide();
				$(this).next('.gnb-cont').show();

				if (gnb_self.find('.gnb-depth-cont.ng-scope').length > 8) {
					$('.ok-header').addClass('h_878');
				} else {
					$('.ok-header').removeClass('h_878');
				}
			});

			$(".ok-header").on('mouseleave blur', function () {
				$('#gnb .gnb-cont').hide();
				$('#ok_header').removeClass('gnb_active');
				$('.ok-header').removeClass('h_878');
			});

			$(".ok-header .btn-link-bank").on('focusout', function () {
				$('#gnb .gnb-cont').hide();
				$('#ok_header').removeClass('gnb_active');
				$('.ok-header').removeClass('h_878');
			});
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시, 화면 이동
		// ====================================	
		function evtMoveToFirstPage(menuCd) {

			var headerMenuCd = '';
			var currMenuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[menuCd];

			if (currMenuInfo.menuLvl == 1 || currMenuInfo.menuLvl == 2) {
				headerMenuCd = currMenuInfo.menuCd;
			}

			var firstMenuCd = getFirstMenuCd(headerMenuCd);
			var firstMenuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[firstMenuCd];

			$utilService.go(firstMenuInfo.menuUrl, { menuCd: firstMenuInfo.menuCd });
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시 하위에 첫번째 url이 걸린 menuCd 반환.
		// ====================================	
		function getFirstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
			var resultMenuCd = '';

			var firstMenuCd = function firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
				var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCd];
				var preIdx = 0;

				for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo['subMenuList'].length; i++) {

					if ($scope.allMenuList[menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd]['subMenuList'].length) {
						firstMenuCd(menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd);
					}

					if (!resultMenuCd) {
						if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].leafYn === 'Y' && menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuUrl) {
							resultMenuCd = menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			};

			firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd);

			return resultMenuCd;
		};

		// =================================		
		// 클릭 메뉴 화면 이동
		// =================================	
		function evtMoveToPage(menuInfo) {

			console.log(menuInfo);

			if (menuInfo.menuUrl == "/mbrPntMallLanding") {
				$utilService.openAlert("포인트몰 점검중입니다.\n이용에 불편드려 죄송합니다.");
				return;
			}

			if (menuInfo.leafYn == 'Y' && menuInfo.menuUrl) {
				$utilService.go(menuInfo.menuUrl, { menuCd: menuInfo.menuCd });
			} else {
				if (menuInfo.subList.length) {
					for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo.subList.length; i++) {
						if (menuInfo.subList[i].menuUrl) {
							console.log(menuInfo.subList[i]);
							console.log(menuInfo.subList[i].menuUrl + "||" + menuInfo.subList[i].menuCd);
							$utilService.go(menuInfo.subList[i].menuUrl, { menuCd: menuInfo.subList[i].menuCd });
							break;
						}
					}
				} else {
					if (menuInfo.otsdUrl.indexOf('http:/') >= 0 || menuInfo.otsdUrl.indexOf('https:/') >= 0) {
						window.open(menuInfo.otsdUrl, '_blank');
					}
				}
			}
		}

		// =================================
		// HEADER BANNER PAGE 이동
		// =================================
		function evtBnrMoveToPage(url, param) {

			if (url) {
				if (url.indexOf('http:/') >= 0 || url.indexOf('https:/') >= 0) {
					window.open(url, '_blank');
				} else {
					if (url == "/cnsmFncDtntDclrCenr") {
						param = { menuCd: "00002" };
					}
					$utilService.go(url, param);
				}
			}
		}

		//엔터 이벤트 처리
		function evtEnterClick(e, url, param) {
			e.stopImmediatePropagation();
			var keyCode = e.which || e.keyCode;
			if (keyCode === 13) {
				evtBnrMoveToPage(url, param);
			}
		}

		// =================================
		// 홈 메인 변경 (OK 저축은행 이미지 로고 클릭)
		// =================================
		function homeMenuChangeFun(type) {
			//$utilService.go('/main');
			window.location.reload();
		}

		// =================================

			$utilService.go('/cmnTotMenuRenewal', { menuCd: '02441' });
		}

		$scope.event.init();
		evntDataCheck();

		// 페이지 변경 시  현재 url 대메뉴 구조와 클릭된 url 대메뉴 구조가 다를 경우 변경되는 url 메뉴 구조로 변경을 위함.
		$utilService.setAllMenuReLoadFun(function (toState, formState, location, toParams, fromParams) {

			var type = 0;

			if (formState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0 && !toState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0) {
				type = 1;
			} else if (!formState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0 && toState.url.indexOf('/lon/') == 0) {
				type = 2;
			}

			// type == 1 : 전 플랫폼이 대출이고 이동 플랫폼이 홈일 경우
			// type == 2 : 전 플랫폼이 홈이고 이동 폴랫폼이 대출일 경우
			switch (type) {
				case 1:
					$scope.homeFlag = true;
					break;

				case 2:
					$scope.homeFlag = false;
					break;
			}

			evtInit();
		});
	}

	module.exports = md;

			}
			if (location) {
				setLocation(location);
			}
			if (param) {
				$utilService.go(url, param);
			} else {
				$utilService.go(url);
			}

			$rootScope.title = title;
		}

			if (!$rootScope['location']) {

			}
			if (location.indexOf('>') != -1) {
				var locationArray = location.split('>');
				$.each(locationArray, function (idx) {
					$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: locationArray[idx] };
				});
			}
		}

			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({}, { service: 'SCustInfoMang', operation: 'getMaInfoContDeps' })).then(function (data) {
				console.log('getMaInfoContDeps                     ===============> data', data);
				if (data.SMaInfoContDeps01OutDto) {
					$.each(data.SMaInfoContDeps01OutDto, function (key) {
						switch (key) {
							case 'depsInrt01List':
								//예적금금리
								if (data.SMaInfoContDeps01OutDto[key]) {
									$utilService.createDataMergeTabel($('#depsinrt01list'), data.SMaInfoContDeps01OutDto[key]);
								}
								break;
							case 'fxngInfo':
								$.each(data.SMaInfoContDeps01OutDto[key], function (key2) {
									$scope.data[key][key2] = data.SMaInfoContDeps01OutDto[key][key2];
								});
								break;
						}
					});
				}
			});
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();

				acmlMthd: $utilService.getParamVal('acmlMthd') == null ? '00000' : $utilService.getParamVal('acmlMthd'),

		// 4. 조회
		function evtSrcClick(pageNo) {
			if (!pageNo) {
				$scope.data.pageNo = 1;
				$scope.data.totalCount = 0;
			} else if (!isNaN(pageNo)) {
				$scope.data.pageNo = pageNo;
			}

			if ($scope.data.mngmTr == "00000") {
				$scope.data.mngmTr = '';
			}
			if ($scope.data.inrtTp == "00000") {
				$scope.data.inrtTp = '';
			}
			if ($scope.data.etryMthd == "00000") {
				$scope.data.etryMthd = '';
			}
			if ($scope.data.acmlMthd == "00000") {
				$scope.data.acmlMthd = '';
			}
			if ($scope.data.entrObjc == "00000") {
				$scope.data.entrObjc = '';
			}

			var selIntrArayData = $('div[data=inrtArayData]').find('div.bx-select-header').find('a').text();
			$('div[data=inrtArayData]').find('div.bx-select-header').find('a').attr('title', selIntrArayData + ' 선택됨');

			// ==================================================================
			// rest 서비스 호출
			// ==================================================================		
			var data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, null);
			if ($scope.data.isIncPbanRoom) {
				data.menuCd = '00000';
				getSearchList(data);
			} else {
				if ($scope.data.menuCd) {
					getSearchList($scope.data);
				} else {
					$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ url: $state.current.url }, { service: 'SMenuMang', operation: 'getPcMenuOneFindByUrl' })).then(function (data) {
						if (data.SMaMenu01OutSubDto) {
							$scope.data.menuCd = data.SMaMenu01OutSubDto.menuCd;
						}
						getSearchList($scope.data);
					});
				}
			}
		}

		function getSearchList(data) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(data, { service: 'SGdsDepsMang', operation: 'getMaGdsDepsList' })).then(function (data) {
				if (data.SMaGdsDeps01OutDto.sub) {
					$scope.data.totalCount = data.SMaGdsDeps01OutDto.totalCount; // 총 건수 세팅

					$scope.selectObject = data.SMaGdsDeps01OutDto.sub;

					$.each($scope.selectObject, function (key) {
						if ($scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt != null) {
							var etryLowsAmt = $scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt.toString();
							if (etryLowsAmt >= 10000) {
								$scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt = etryLowsAmt.substr(0, etryLowsAmt.length - 4) + "만원";
							} else {
								$scope.selectObject[key].etryLowsAmt = etryLowsAmt + "원";
							}
						}
					});
				}

				if ($scope.data.mngmTr == "") {
					$scope.data.mngmTr = '00000';
				}
				if ($scope.data.inrtTp == "") {
					$scope.data.inrtTp = '00000';
				}
				if ($scope.data.etryMthd == "") {
					$scope.data.etryMthd = '00000';
				}
				if ($scope.data.acmlMthd == "") {
					$scope.data.acmlMthd = '00000';
				}
				if ($scope.data.entrObjc == "") {
					$scope.data.entrObjc = '00000';
				}
			});
		}

		// 5. 이동
		function evtMoveToPage(no) {
			var key = { depsGdsSqno: no, pageNo: $scope.data.pageNo, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
				mngmTr: $scope.data.mngmTr, inrtTp: $scope.data.inrtTp,
				etryMthd: $scope.data.etryMthd, acmlMthd: $scope.data.acmlMthd, entrObjc: $scope.data.entrObjc,
				frdmEtryMthd: $scope.data.etryMthd
			};

			$utilService.go($scope.data.url, key);
		}

		function evtGoPage(pageNo) {
			evtSrcClick(pageNo);
		}

		function evtGoPage2(title, location, url, param) {
			if (title) {
				setTitle(title);
			}
			if (location) {
				setLocation(location);
			}
			if (param) {
				$utilService.go(url, param);
			} else {
				$utilService.go(url);
			}
		}

		function setTitle(title) {
			$rootScope.title = title;
		}

		function setLocation(location) {
			if (!$rootScope['location']) {
				$rootScope['location'] = new Array(4);
			}
			if (location.indexOf('>') != -1) {
				var locationArray = location.split('>');
				$.each(locationArray, function (idx) {
					$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: locationArray[idx] };
				});
			}
		}

		function evtSnsShare(tp, no) {
			var snsShareUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/#" + $scope.data.url + "?depsGdsSqno=" + no + "&menuCd=" + $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');
			console.log("================ snsShareUrl : ", snsShareUrl);
			$snsService.snsShare(tp, snsShareUrl);
		}

		$scope.data.mngmTrBk = "00000";
		$scope.data.inrtTpBk = "00000";
		$scope.data.etryMthdBk = "00000";
		$scope.data.acmlMthdBk = "00000";
		$scope.data.entrObjcBk = "00000";
		function evtBtCheck(m, n) {
			if (n) {
				if (m == "data.mngmTr") {
					$scope.data.mngmTrBk = $scope.data.mngmTr;
				}
				if (m == "data.inrtTp") {
					$scope.data.inrtTpBk = $scope.data.inrtTp;
				}
				if (m == "data.etryMthd") {
					$scope.data.etryMthdBk = $scope.data.etryMthd;
				}
				if (m == "data.acmlMthd") {
					$scope.data.acmlMthdBk = $scope.data.acmlMthd;
				}
				if (m == "data.entrObjc") {
					$scope.data.entrObjcBk = $scope.data.entrObjc;
				}
			} else {
				if (m == "data.mngmTr") {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.mngmTrData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.mngmTrData, $scope.data.mngmTrBk);
					});
				}
				if (m == "data.inrtTp") {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.inrtTpData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.inrtTpData, $scope.data.inrtTpBk);
					});
				}
				if (m == "data.etryMthd") {
					if ($scope.etryMthdShow) {
						$timeout(function () {
							$scope.etryMthdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.etryMthdData, $scope.data.etryMthdBk);
						});
					} else {
						$timeout(function () {
							$scope.frdmEtryMthdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.frdmEtryMthdData, $scope.data.etryMthdBk);
						});
					}
				}
				if (m == "data.acmlMthd") {
					$timeout(function () {
						$scope.acmlMthdData = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.acmlMthdData, $scope.data.acmlMthdBk);
					});
				}
				if (m == "data.entrObjc") {

		function getSearchList(data) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(data, { service: 'SGdsDepsMang', operation: 'getMaGdsDepsList' })).then(function (data) {
				if (data.SMaGdsDeps01OutDto.sub) {

		function setLocation(location) {
			if (!$rootScope['location']) {
				$rootScope['location'] = new Array(4);

			if (location.indexOf('>') != -1) {
				var locationArray = location.split('>');
				$.each(locationArray, function (idx) {
					$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: locationArray[idx] };
				});
			}
		}

		// 사용자 지정 콜백 함수
		// ==================================================================
		// 5. 초기화 데이터 호출
		function initSearch() {

			// ==================================================================
			// rest 서비스 호출
			// ==================================================================
			// 상세내역 조회

			var data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, null);
			if ($scope.data.isIncPbanRoom) {
				data.menuCd = '00000';
				data.gdsClsnCd = "";
			}

			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(data, { service: 'SGdsInsrMang', operation: 'getGdsInsrMang' })).then(function (data) {
				if (data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto) {

					$.each(data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto, function (key) {
						switch (key) {
							case 'dtlCont':
								if (data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key]) {
									$.each(data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key], function (key2) {
										$scope.data[key][key2] = data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key][key2];
									});
								}
								break;
							case 'fileList1':
								$scope.downloadUrl1 = (0, _typeof3.default)(data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key][0]) === 'object' ? data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key][0]['filePathNm'] : null;
								break;
							case 'fileList2':
								$scope.downloadUrl2 = (0, _typeof3.default)(data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key][0]) === 'object' ? data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key][0]['filePathNm'] : null;
								break;
							case 'concGdsList':
								if (data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key]) {
									$scope.concGdsObj = data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key];

									//			    					   $.each(data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key], function(idx){
									//										   $scope.concGdsObj=data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key][idx]
									//			    					   });
								}
								break;
							default:
								$scope.data[key] = data.SMaGdsInsr01OutSubDto[key];
						}
					});
				} else {
					$utilService.openAlert('존재하지 않는 상품입니다.', function () {
						$scope.incEvent.moveToPage();
					});
				}
			});

			// ==================================================================
			// rest 서비스 호출
			// ==================================================================
			// 이전 다음 목록 조회
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson(data, { service: 'SGdsInsrMang', operation: 'getPrevNextPage' })).then(function (data) {
				if (data.SMaGdsInsr02OutSubDto) {
					$.each(data.SMaGdsInsr02OutSubDto, function (key) {
						$scope.data[key] = data.SMaGdsInsr02OutSubDto[key];
					});
				}
			});
		}

		// 8. 목록 이동
		function evtMoveToPage(concTp, concSqno, menuCd, menuUrl) {

			if (concTp) {
				if (menuCd == $scope.data.menuCd) {
					$scope.data.url = menuUrl;
					$scope.data.insrGdsSqno = concSqno;

					initSearch();
					$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);

					var key = { insrGdsSqno: concSqno, pageNo: $scope.data.pageNo, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
						iscmCdArray: $utilService.getParamVal('iscmCdArray')
					};

					$utilService.go($scope.data.url, key, $scope, function () {
						initSearch();
						$("html,body").animate({ scrollTop: 0 }, 0);
					});
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { insrGdsSqno: concSqno, menuCd: menuCd });
				}
			} else {
				var locationPath = $location.$$path;
				$scope.data.url = locationPath.substr(0, locationPath.length - 3) + "List";

				var key = { pageNo: $scope.data.pageNo, menuCd: $scope.data.menuCd,
					iscmCdArray: $utilService.getParamVal('iscmCdArray')
				};

				$utilService.go($scope.data.url, key);
			}
		}

		function fileSelectedFun(fileObj) {
			console.log(fileObj);
		}

		function evtCopyUrl() {
			$utilService.openAlert('해당 상품의 URL이 복사되었습니다. CTRL+V 또는 우측 마우스 붙여 넣기로 복사하여 이용해주세요.').focus;
			$utilService.getUrlCopy();
		}

		function evtSnsShare(tp) {
			//		var sendUrl = document.location;
			var snsShareUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/#" + $location.$$path + "?insrGdsSqno=" + $utilService.getParamVal('insrGdsSqno') + "&menuCd=" + $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd');
			console.log("================ snsShareUrl : ", snsShareUrl);
			$snsService.snsShare(tp, snsShareUrl);
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.controller('incGdsInsrListController', __controller);

	/* @ngInject */
	function __controller($scope, $state, $stateParams, $rootScope, $timeout, $commonService, $utilService, $location, $snsService) {

		/*보험상품 목록*/
		if (!$scope.data) {
			$scope.data = {};
		}

		$scope.iscmCdArray = [];

		// ==================================================================
		// set incEvent listener
		// ==================================================================
		// 2. 이벤트선언
		$scope.incEvent = {
			init: evtInit,
			moveToPage: evtMoveToPage // 화면이동
			, srchClick: evtSrchClick // 조회
			, goPage: evtGoPage // 화면이동
			, snsShare: evtSnsShare // sns 연동
			, allCheck: evtAllCheck // 전체체크
			, allNoCheck: evtallNoCheck // 전체체크 제거
			, enterClick: evtEnterClick //input 엔터시 이벤트 함수 호출
		};

		// 3. 초기화
		$scope.dataTagNm = {};

		//상품 정렬순서
		$scope.gdsArayData = [{ label: '오름차순', value: 'asc' }, { label: '내림차순', value: 'desc' }];

		//특정태그 코드
		$scope.charTagCdData = [{ label: '인터넷뱅킹', value: '00001' }, { label: '모바일', value: '00002' }, { label: '영업점', value: '00003' }, { label: '예금자보호', value: '00004' }, { label: '비과세', value: '00005' }, { label: '온라인전용', value: '00006' }];

		// ==================================================================
		// set incEvent function
		// ==================================================================
		// 화면 초기화 function
		function evtInit() {
			$scope.data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, {
				gdsClsnCd: '00001' // 보험유형(C2060)
				, iscmCd: '' // 보험사(C2061)
				, pageNo: $utilService.getParamVal('pageNo') == null ? 1 : $utilService.getParamVal('pageNo'),
				menuCd: $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd') == null ? '' : $utilService.getParamVal('menuCd'),
				rowNum: 10,
				gdsAray: 'asc',
				url: '',
				totalCount: 0,
				stsCd: '00002',
				iscmCdArray: $utilService.getParamVal('iscmCdArray') == null ? '' : $utilService.getParamVal('iscmCdArray')
			});

			// 공통코드에 전체 항목 추가
			$scope.iscmCd00 = [{
				label: "전체",
				value: "Y"
			}];

			if ($scope.data.iscmCdArray != "") {
				$scope.iscmCd00 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.iscmCd00, "N");
			} else {
				$scope.iscmCd00 = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.iscmCd00, "Y");
			}

			// 4-1. 공통코드
			$commonService.getCmnCdSubList('C2061', function (data) {
				$scope.iscmCd = data['C2061']; //[보험사]
				$scope.iscmCd = $utilService.getDefaultChecked($scope.iscmCd, $scope.data.iscmCdArray);
			});

			//상세화면이동 페이지 작성
			var locationPath = $location.$$path;
			var locationPathCmnNm = locationPath.substr(0, locationPath.length - 4);

		// url치환 function
		function urlVaild(data, key) {

			for (var i = 0; i < data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key].length; i++) {
				var tempInfoMap = data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i];
				var contRst = tempInfoMap.cont.replace(/\n/g, "<br>");
				var urlSrh = tempInfoMap.cont.match(/@.*?@/g);
				if (urlSrh) {
					var redirectUrl = urlSrh[0].match(/\(.*?\)/g);
					redirectUrl = redirectUrl[0].replace(/\(|\)/g, "");
					var urlName = urlSrh[0].replace("(" + redirectUrl + ")", "");

					//모바일url과 홈페이지 url 이 달라 정상로드되지 않는경우 
					if ("/#/bank_bsbr_gd" == redirectUrl) {
						//영업점안내
						redirectUrl = "/#/bankBsbrGd";
					}

					urlName = "<a href =" + redirectUrl + " target=\"_blank\" title=\"새창열림\">" + urlName + "</a>";
					data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i].cont = contRst.replace(urlSrh, urlName).replace(/@/g, "");
				} else {
					data.SMaGdsLon01OutSubDto[key][i].cont = contRst;
				}
			}
		}

		//초기화 함수 실행
		$scope.incEvent.init();
	}

				var list = data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.sub;

				var lrclArNm = list[$scope.view.firstChoiceWdarCtdoNmIndex].value;
				evtCggNm(lrclArNm);

				$timeout(function () {
					$scope.view.wdarCtdoNm = list;
				}, 100);
			});
		}

		// 시군구
		function evtCggNm(lrclArNm) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ lrclArNm: lrclArNm }, { service: 'SCmnPopAddrSerch', operation: 'getTbEx3720mList02' }), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {
				var list = data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.sub;

				var mdcfArNm = list[0].value;
				evtTmdNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm);

				$timeout(function () {
					$scope.view.cggNm = list;
				}, 100);
			});
		}

		// 읍면동
		function evtTmdNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ lrclArNm: lrclArNm, mdcfArNm: mdcfArNm }, { service: 'SCmnPopAddrSerch', operation: 'getTbEx3720mList03' }), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {
				var list = data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.sub;

				var smclArNm = list[0].value;
				evtHsngNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm, smclArNm);

				$timeout(function () {
					$scope.view.tmdNm = list;
				}, 100);
			});
		}

		// 단지명
		function evtHsngNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm, smclArNm) {
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ lrclArNm: lrclArNm, mdcfArNm: mdcfArNm, smclArNm: smclArNm }, { service: 'SCmnPopAddrSerch', operation: 'getTbEx3720mList04' }), function (data) {}, false).then(function (data) {
				var list = data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.sub;

				$scope.view.totalcount = data.STbEx3720m01OutDto.totalCount;

				$timeout(function () {
					$scope.view.hsngNm = list;
				}, 100);
			});
		}

		// 아파트 선택
		function evtChoiceHsngNm(obj) {
			//아파트 시세조회 
			console.log(obj);
			evtKbMrvlService(obj);
		}

		// 시세조회
		function evtKbMrvlService(obj) {
			var eaiData = {
				lonCretNo: $scope.data.lonCretNo,
				thngDscnDivs: obj.sqno
			};

			var intrSrch = obj.lrclArNm + ' ' + obj.mdcfArNm + ' ' + obj.smclArNm + ' ' + obj.value;

			$chlBizCmnService.getRealEstateCond(eaiData, function (data) {
				var dto = data.SRealEstateCondOutDto;
				if (dto && dto.subEai.resultCode == '00') {
					var mrvlLst = dto.subEai.mrvlLst;

					$popupService.cmnPopAddrSrch($scope, { intrSrch: intrSrch, isKbMrvNext: true, isCvrgHsYn: $scope.data.isCvrgHsYn, kbMrvData: obj }, function (data) {
						evtOnCallback(mrvlLst, obj.value, data);
					});
				}
			}, function (data) {
				console.log('fail', data);
				$popupService.cmnPopAddrSrch($scope, { intrSrch: intrSrch, isKbMrvNext: true, isCvrgHsYn: $scope.data.isCvrgHsYn, kbMrvData: obj }, function (data) {
					evtOnCallback(null, obj.value, data);
				});
			});
		}

		// 시세정보
		// 추후 등기부 관련개발 추가해야함
		function evtOnCallback(mrvlLst, aptNm, addr) {
			var callbackData = {
				isMrvl: !!mrvlLst, //	true 인경우, 시세 있음, false 인경우 오류로 시세/평형정보 예외처리 진행
				mrvlLst: !!mrvlLst ? mrvlLst : [{ sqms: '0㎡', dlngGnrlAvrgPovs: '0' }],
				aptNm: aptNm
			};

			if (addr) {
				var dongHo = (addr.inpuDtadr || '').replace(/\((.*?)\)/ig, '').replace(/(^s*)|(\s*$)/g, '').split(' ');
				if (dongHo.length == 1) {
					addr.ho = dongHo[0].indexOf('호') > -1 ? dongHo[0].replace('호', '') : '';
				} else if (dongHo.length == 2) {
					addr.dong = dongHo[0].indexOf('동') > -1 ? dongHo[0].replace('동', '') : '';
					addr.ho = dongHo[1].indexOf('호') > -1 ? dongHo[1].replace('호', '') : '';
				}

				callbackData.addr = addr;
			}

			console.log('callbackData', callbackData);

			$scope.$parent.callbackAthz(callbackData);
			evtOnClose();
		}

		function evtOnClose() {
			try {
				$scope.$parent.pager.close();
			} catch (e) {
				$scope.pager.close();
			}
		}

		$scope.event.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;

			console.log('$scope', $scope);

			$scope.data = $scope.$parent.popData || {};

			//주소2 라디오 버튼 클릭

				var mdcfArNm = this.value;
				evtTmdNm(lrclArNm, mdcfArNm);
			});

			});
		}

			var callbackData = {
				isMrvl: !!mrvlLst, //	true 인경우, 시세 있음, false 인경우 오류로 시세/평형정보 예외처리 진행

				aptNm: aptNm

			if (addr) {
				var dongHo = (addr.inpuDtadr || '').replace(/\((.*?)\)/ig, '').replace(/(^s*)|(\s*$)/g, '').split(' ');
				if (dongHo.length == 1) {
					addr.ho = dongHo[0].indexOf('호') > -1 ? dongHo[0].replace('호', '') : '';
				} else if (dongHo.length == 2) {
					addr.dong = dongHo[0].indexOf('동') > -1 ? dongHo[0].replace('동', '') : '';
					addr.ho = dongHo[1].indexOf('호') > -1 ? dongHo[1].replace('호', '') : '';
				}

				callbackData.addr = addr;
			}

			console.log('callbackData', callbackData);

			$scope.$parent.callbackAthz(callbackData);
			evtOnClose();
		}

		function evtOnClose() {
			try {
				$scope.$parent.pager.close();
			} catch (e) {
				$scope.pager.close();
			}
		}

		$scope.event.init();
	}

		function evtFormatCurrency(e) {
			var min = 1000000;
			var max = 50000000;
			console.log(e);
			var obj = e.target;
			var val = obj.value;
			var tmpVal = val.replace(/[^0-9]/gi, '');
			if (tmpVal != '') {
				if (parseInt(tmpVal, 10) > max) {
					tmpVal = max;
				} else if (parseInt(tmpVal, 10) < min) {
					tmpVal = min;
				}

				obj.value = (tmpVal + '').replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
			} else {
				obj.value = 0;
			}
		}

		// 대출원금증가 function

			var max = 50000000;

		function evtNextClick() {
			if ($scope.schMode == 'mode_template01') {
				if (!$scope.data.pathCd) {
					$utilService.openAlert('인지경로를 선택해주세요.');
					return;
				}
				$scope.schMode = 'mode_template02';
			} else if ($scope.schMode == 'mode_template02') {
				if (!$scope.data.day) {
					$utilService.openAlert('현재 OK저축은행과 경기중인 팀을 선택해주세요.');
					return;
				}
				if ($scope.currtDay != $scope.data.day) {
					$utilService.openAlert('현재 OK저축은행과 경기중인 팀이 아닙니다.');
					return;
				}
				$scope.schMode = 'mode_template03';
			}
		}

			$popupService.cmnPopProv($scope, { code: code }, function () {

		}

		function evtDoneClick() {
			$scope.data.tlph = $scope.data.mbphArNo + '-' + $scope.data.mbphOficNo + '-' + $scope.data.mbphEnNo;
			if ($scope.data.agree_01 != 'Y') {
				$utilService.openAlert('개인정보 수집ㆍ이용 동의해야 합니다.');
				return;
			}

			if (!$scope.data.nam) {

					$timeout(function () {

				return;
			}

			if (!$scope.data.tlph) {

				return;
			}

			if ($scope.data.tlph.length < 12) {
				$utilService.openAlert('휴대전화번호를 입력해 주세요');
				return;
			}

			var provCont = $('#title_agree_01').text() + '=' + $operationUtil.getYN($scope.data.agree_01);

			var eaiData = {
				clbcRqstPathCd: '00002', //콜백요청경로코드 // 00002 (상담신청)

				provCont: provCont
			};

			var mbphTlno = $scope.data.tlph.replace(/-/g, ''); //휴대폰번호
			if (mbphTlno) {
				if (mbphTlno.length == 10) {
					eaiData.mbphArNo = mbphTlno.substring(0, 3);
					eaiData.mbphOficNo = mbphTlno.substring(3, 6);
					eaiData.mbphEnNo = mbphTlno.substring(6);

					eaiData.mbphArNo = mbphTlno.substring(0, 3);

			}
		}

		// =================================	
		// 전체메뉴 MAP 형태 변환
		// =================================
		function renewalTotMenuConvertToMap(data, pMenuData) {

			var menuData = pMenuData;
			var menuList = [];
			var menuMap = {};

			if (data) {

				$.each(menuData, function (menuIdx) {

					$.each(data, function (idx) {

						if (menuData[menuIdx]['menuCd'] == data[idx]['menuCd']) {
							menuList.push(data[idx]);
						}
					});
				});

				$.each(data, function (idx) {

					if (!data[idx]['subList']) {
						data[idx]['subList'] = [];
					}

					if (menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]) {
						menuMap[[data[idx].parentMenuCd]]['subList'].push(data[idx]);
					}

					menuMap[data[idx].menuCd] = data[idx];
				});
			}

			return menuList;
		}

		// ====================================	
		// 대메뉴 클릭 시 하위에 첫번째 url이 걸린 menuCd 반환.
		// ====================================	
		function getFirstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
			var resultMenuCd = '';

			var firstMenuCd = function firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd) {
				var menuInfo = $scope.allMenuList[parentMenuCd];
				var preIdx = 0;

				for (var i = 0; i < menuInfo['subMenuList'].length; i++) {

					if ($scope.allMenuList[menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd]['subMenuList'].length) {
						firstMenuCd(menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd);
					}

					if (!resultMenuCd) {
						if (menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].leafYn === 'Y' && menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuUrl) {
							resultMenuCd = menuInfo['subMenuList'][i].menuCd;
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			};

			firstMenuCd(parentMenuCd);

			return resultMenuCd;
		};

		function getSlctCdsList() {

			var strResult = '';
			var comma = ',';
			var maxLength = $scope.slctCdsList.length - 1;

			var result = new Array();

			$.each($scope.slctCdsList, function (idx) {

				if (idx < maxLength) {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx] + comma;
				} else {
					strResult = strResult + $scope.slctCdsList[idx];
				}
			});

			result.push(strResult);

			return result;
		}

		function evtLonLayerMoveToPage(menuUrl, menuCd, lonGdsSqno) {

			if (menuUrl) {
				if (menuCd) {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl, { 'menuCd': menuCd, 'lonGdsSqno': lonGdsSqno });
				} else {
					$utilService.go(menuUrl);
				}
			}
		}

				setTitle(title);
			}
			if (location) {
				setLocation(location);
			}
			if (param) {
				$utilService.go(url, param);
			} else {
				$utilService.go(url);
			}

			if (!$rootScope['location']) {

			}
			if (location.indexOf('>') != -1) {
				var locationArray = location.split('>');
				$.each(locationArray, function (idx) {
					$rootScope.location[idx] = { idx: idx, menuNm: locationArray[idx] };
				});
			}
		}

/***/ "./views/redirect/redirect_controller.js":
/*!***********************************************!*\
  !*** ./views/redirect/redirect_controller.js ***!
  \***********************************************/
/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.controller('redirectController', __controller);

	/* @ngInject */
	function __controller($scope, $state, $commonService, $utilService, $location, $sessionStorageService) {

		$scope.data = {};

		$scope.event = {
			init: evtInit
		};

		function evtInit() {

			var params = getSearchParams();

			//url 데이터 반환
			$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson($scope.data, { service: 'SCustInfoMang', operation: 'getLandInfo' }), function (data) {
				if (data['header'].rspnCd != '0') {
					//에러시 메인 이동
					$utilService.go('/main');
				}
			}).then(function (data) {
				if (data.SLandingInfo01OutDto && data.SLandingInfo01OutDto.url) {
					var url = data.SLandingInfo01OutDto.url;
					var externalInfo = data.SLandingInfo01OutDto.externalInfo;

					if (params) {
						url = url + (url.indexOf('?') != -1 ? '&' : '?') + params;
					}

					if ($scope.data.pageCd == 'LND000L31') {
						if (externalInfo) {
							if ($scope.data.hycKey) {
								$sessionStorageService.set('hyc', externalInfo); //현대 캐피탈 복호화값 
							} else {
								$sessionStorageService.set('externalInfo', externalInfo); //redirect.jsp에서온 복호화 데이터
							}
						} else {
							if ($scope.data.ch && $scope.data.no) {
								$sessionStorageService.set('hyc', { 'chnlCd': $scope.data.ch, 'acptNo': $scope.data.no });
							} else {
								var msg = '현대 캐피탈 연결 정보가 존재하지 않습니다.';
								$('#redirect_msg').html(msg);
								$utilService.openAlert(msg);
								return;
							}
						}
					}

					location.replace(url);
				}
			});
		}

		function getSearchParams() {
			var params = [];

			if ($location.$$search) {
				$scope.data.pageCd = $location.$$search['p'] || '';
				$scope.data.hycKey = $location.$$search['key'] || '';
				$scope.data.ch = $location.$$search['ch'] || '';
				$scope.data.no = $location.$$search['no'] || '';
				if ($scope.data.pageCd) {
					$.each($location.$$search, function (key, value) {
						if (key != 'p' && key.indexOf('utm_') == -1 && key != 'key' && key != 'ch' && key != 'no') {
							params.push(key + '=' + value);
						}
					});
				}
			}

			if (!$scope.data.pageCd) {
				if ($location.$$absUrl) {
					var paramStr = /[^/#/]*/.exec(/[^?]*$/.exec($location.$$absUrl)[0])[0];
					if (paramStr && paramStr.indexOf('http') != 0) {
						var value = '';
						paramStr.split('&').map(function (val) {
							var valArray = val.split('=');
							if (valArray[0] == 'p') {
								$scope.data.pageCd = valArray[1];
							} else if (valArray[0] == 'key') {
								$scope.data.hycKey = valArray[1];
							} else if (valArray[0] == 'ch') {
								$scope.data.ch = valArray[1];
							} else if (valArray[0] == 'no') {
								$scope.data.no = valArray[1];
							} else if (valArray[0].indexOf('utm_') == -1) {
								params.push(decodeUrl(val));
							}
						});
					}
				}
			}
			return params.join('&');
		}

		function decodeUrl(val) {
			try {
				return decodeURIComponent(val);
			} catch (e) {
				return val;
			}
		}

		$scope.event.init();
	}

	module.exports = md;

/***/ "./views/test/popup/test_api_data_controller.js":
/*!******************************************************!*\
  !*** ./views/test/popup/test_api_data_controller.js ***!

/***/ function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {

	'use strict';

	var md = __webpack_require__(/*! ../../../app_module */ "./app_module.js");

	md.controller('testApiDataController', __controller);

	/* @ngInject */
	//function __controller($scope, $restConfigService, $restService, httpHeader){
	function __controller($scope, $state, $timeout, $commonService, $utilService, $snsService, $popupService, cnvtFactory) {

		$scope.data = {};

		function init() {
			$scope.data = $.extend({}, $scope.data, $scope.$parent.popData);

			console.log('testApiDataController   $scope.data   ', $scope.data);

			setData();
		}

		function setData() {
			$scope.input = $utilService.replaceAll(angular.toJson(angular.fromJson($utilService.getJson($scope.data.input, {}))['data']), ',"', '</br>,"');

			var text = $utilService.replaceAll(angular.toJson($scope.data.output), ',"', '</br>,"');

			text = $utilService.replaceAll(text, '{"', '</br>{"');

			$.each($scope.classNm, function (key) {
				text = $utilService.replaceAll(text, key, '<a href="javascript:;" data-classnm="' + $scope.classNm[key] + '">' + key + '<div style="color : red;"></div></a>');
			});

			$scope.output = text;

			$timeout(function () {
				$('#output').find('a').bind('click', function () {
					var obj = $(this);
					if (obj.data('viewflag')) {
						obj.data('viewflag', false);
						obj.find('div').html('');
					} else {
						$commonService.getPostServerCall($utilService.getJson({ fullClassNm: obj.data('classnm') }, { service: 'STestMang', operation: 'getDtoInfo' }), null, false).then(function (data) {
							console.log('data=========>', data);
							obj.find('div').html($utilService.replaceAll(data.SDtoInfo01OutDto.classInfo, ',"', '</br>,"'));
							obj.data('viewflag', true);
						});
					}
				});
			}, 500);
		}

		init();
	}

	module.exports = md;
